summary.zh_hant: 在立法會財經事務委員會會議上，有議員關注近期歐美國債收益率急升，內地國債收益率則保持平穩，外匯基金會否調整債券資產配置。金管局副總裁李達志表示，過去幾年參與的內地國債投資表現不錯，雖然孳息率持續下降，但債券價值上升，匯兌方面亦錄得收益；去年內地的國債投資回報率達到約7%左右，形容是相當好的投資，未來會繼續審慎地分布投資。他說，外匯基金早期投資人民幣，看中中國市場與其他海外市場的聯繫度較低，強調會確保不同資產在不同經濟周期都能獲得一定保障。李達志又指，目前市場預期美國聯儲局今年會再加息一次，但市場情緒轉變可以非常快，當局會繼續視乎當地經濟、通脹及數據變化調整貨幣政策；作為大型機構投資者，不能簡單「賭大細」，亦不能每天頻繁進出市場。他承認分散投資的難度越來越高，因為環球股票投資配置高度集中在美股，甚至聚焦市值最大的股票。
summary.en: At a Legislative Council finance panel meeting, lawmakers asked whether the Exchange Fund would adjust its bond allocation after US and European government bond yields surged while mainland yields stayed stable. HKMA Deputy Chief Executive Howard Lee said the Fund's mainland government bond investments have performed well in recent years: although yields have kept falling, bond values have risen and foreign-exchange gains were recorded, with returns of about 7 per cent last year — a very good investment — and the Fund will continue to diversify cautiously. He said the Fund's early renminbi investments were driven by the Chinese market's low correlation with other overseas markets, stressing that different assets must be protected across different economic cycles. Lee added that markets currently expect the US Federal Reserve to raise rates once more this year, but sentiment can change very fast, and policy will be adjusted in line with US economic, inflation and data developments; as a large institutional investor, the Fund cannot simply gamble or trade in and out daily. He acknowledged diversification is getting harder as global equity allocations are heavily concentrated in US stocks, even in the largest-cap names.
summary.zh_hans: 在立法会财经事务委员会会议上，有议员关注近期欧美国债收益率急升，内地国债收益率则保持平稳，外汇基金会否调整债券资产配置。金管局副总裁李达志表示，过去几年参与的内地国债投资表现不错，虽然孳息率持续下降，但债券价值上升，汇兑方面亦录得收益；去年内地的国债投资回报率达到约7%左右，形容是相当好的投资，未来会继续审慎地分布投资。他说，外汇基金早期投资人民币，看中中国市场与其他海外市场的联系度较低，强调会确保不同资产在不同经济周期都能获得一定保障。李达志又指，目前市场预期美国联储局今年会再加息一次，但市场情绪转变可以非常快，当局会继续视乎当地经济、通胀及数据变化调整货币政策；作为大型机构投资者，不能简单「赌大细」，亦不能每天频繁进出市场。他承认分散投资的难度越来越高，因为环球股票投资配置高度集中在美股，甚至聚焦市值最大的股票。

title.zh_hant: 警隊紀念日悼念殉職同袍　周一鳴特別提及朱振國：遺志引領警隊追求卓越
title.en: Force Remembrance Day: Police chief Chow Yat-ming pays tribute to fallen officers, singles out Chu Chun-kwok's legacy
title.zh_hans: 警队纪念日悼念殉职同袍　周一鸣特别提及朱振国：遗志引领警队追求卓越

summary.zh_hant: 警務處處長周一鳴今日上午在警察總部主持警隊紀念日儀式，聯同輔警總監梁世光及各單位代表，悼念歷年因公殉職的警務人員。周一鳴致辭時表示，殉職人員以寶貴生命換來香港的安全與穩定，其犧牲提醒每名警務人員傳承信念與使命。他特別提及高級警員朱振國，2005年執勤時遇襲受傷，留院至今年9月離世；朱振國與其他殉職人員的奉獻精神，引領警隊不斷創新、追求卓越，致力成為亞洲最優秀的警隊。儀式上，警察樂隊號手吹奏「最後崗位」，全場默哀兩分鐘，周一鳴及各代表先後在載有殉職人員姓名的紀念冊前獻花。
summary.en: Commissioner of Police Chow Yat-ming led the Force Remembrance Day ceremony at Police Headquarters this morning, joined by Auxiliary Police Commandant Leung Sai-kwong and representatives of police formations, to pay tribute to officers who died in the line of duty. Chow said the fallen officers gave their lives for Hong Kong's security and stability, and their sacrifice reminds every officer to carry forward their beliefs and mission. He singled out Senior Police Constable Chu Chun-kwok, who was attacked on duty in 2005 and remained in hospital until his death in September this year, saying Chu's dedication, like that of all fallen officers, guides the Force to keep innovating and pursuing excellence as Asia's finest. A bugler sounded the Last Post, the ceremony observed two minutes' silence, and wreaths were laid before the Books of Remembrance.
summary.zh_hans: 警务处处长周一鸣今日上午在警察总部主持警队纪念日仪式，联同辅警总监梁世光及各单位代表，悼念历年因公殉职的警务人员。周一鸣致辞时表示，殉职人员以宝贵生命换来香港的安全与稳定，其牺牲提醒每名警务人员传承信念与使命。他特别提及高级警员朱振国，2005年执勤时遇袭受伤，留院至今年9月离世；朱振国与其他殉职人员的奉献精神，引领警队不断创新、追求卓越，致力成为亚洲最优秀的警队。仪式上，警察乐队号手吹奏「最后岗位」，全场默哀两分钟，周一鸣及各代表先后在载有殉职人员姓名的纪念册前献花。

title.zh_hant: 澳門首宗國安案宣判　前議員區錦新判囚12年半　兩項顛覆罪不成立
title.en: Macau's first national security trial: former lawmaker Au Kam-san jailed for 12.5 years; two subversion counts dismissed
title.zh_hans: 澳门首宗国安案宣判　前议员区锦新判囚12年半　两项颠覆罪不成立

summary.zh_hant: 澳門初級法院今日就本澳首宗國安法案件宣判，前立法會議員區錦新被裁定顛覆國家政權罪、與境外組織建立聯繫危害國家安全罪及違反保密罪罪成，數罪並罰判囚12年6個月。法庭指，區錦新長期協助及配合境外組織，收集及散播被認定涉及顛覆主張及失實資訊，意圖煽動居民對中央政府產生仇恨；顛覆國家政權罪判囚11年3個月，違反保密罪判囚9個月。至於另外兩項顛覆國家政權罪，法庭認為證據未能達到推翻或破壞國家根本制度的要求，裁定不成立。區錦新現年69歲，去年7月底被捕，是澳門《維護國家安全法》生效以來首名被捕人士，案件9月以閉門方式審訊。
summary.en: Macau's Court of First Instance today sentenced former lawmaker Au Kam-san to 12 years and six months in prison in the city's first national security trial. Au was convicted of subversion of state power, establishing links with organisations outside Macau to endanger national security, and breach of confidentiality. The court found he had long assisted foreign organisations in collecting and spreading material deemed to promote subversion and false information, seeking to incite hatred of the central government; subversion drew 11 years and three months, and breach of confidentiality nine months. Two further subversion counts were dismissed, with the court finding the evidence did not meet the threshold of seeking to overthrow or undermine the state's fundamental system. The 69-year-old was arrested in July last year, the first person detained under Macau's National Security Law, and the case was heard behind closed doors in September.
summary.zh_hans: 澳门初级法院今日就本澳首宗国安法案件宣判，前立法会议员区锦新被裁定颠覆国家政权罪、与境外组织建立联系危害国家安全罪及违反保密罪罪成，数罪并罚判囚12年6个月。法庭指，区锦新长期协助及配合境外组织，收集及散播被认定涉及颠覆主张及失实资讯，意图煽动居民对中央政府产生仇恨；颠覆国家政权罪判囚11年3个月，违反保密罪判囚9个月。至于另外两项颠覆国家政权罪，法庭认为证据未能达到推翻或破坏国家根本制度的要求，裁定不成立。区锦新现年69岁，去年7月底被捕，是澳门《维护国家安全法》生效以来首名被捕人士，案件9月以闭门方式审讯。

title.zh_hant: 恒指半日挫263點　AI股遭恐慌拋售　韓股曾熔斷　港股跑贏區內
title.en: Hang Seng down 263 points at midday as AI sell-off rattles Asia; Korean market briefly triggers circuit breaker
title.zh_hans: 恒指半日挫263点　AI股遭恐慌抛售　韩股曾熔断　港股跑赢区内

summary.zh_hant: 隔夜美股大跌，人工智能相關股份被恐慌式拋售，拖累亞太區主要股市今早受壓，韓股早段一度急跌逾8%，觸發熔斷機制暫停交易20分鐘，其後低位回穩。港股跑贏區內主要指數，恒生指數今早曾跌近450點，低見24349點，其後跌幅收窄，半日收報24533點，跌263點，跌幅約1.1%。人工智能概念股受壓，內需及公用股受捧。
summary.en: Overnight losses on Wall Street and a panic sell-off in artificial intelligence shares dragged Asia's major markets lower this morning, with South Korean stocks at one point plunging more than 8 per cent and triggering a 20-minute trading halt. Hong Kong outperformed the region: the Hang Seng Index fell nearly 450 points at its low of 24,349 before narrowing its losses to close the morning at 24,533, down 263 points or about 1.1 per cent. AI-related stocks were under pressure, while domestic consumption and utilities stocks found support.
summary.zh_hans: 隔夜美股大跌，人工智能相关股份被恐慌式抛售，拖累亚太区主要股市今早受压，韩股早段一度急跌逾8%，触发熔断机制暂停交易20分钟，其后低位回稳。港股跑赢区内主要指数，恒生指数今早曾跌近450点，低见24349点，其后跌幅收窄，半日收报24533点，跌263点，跌幅约1.1%。人工智能概念股受压，内需及公用股受捧。

title.zh_hant: 金管局：打擊傀儡戶口要平衡風險與營商便利　中小企成騙案重災區
title.en: HKMA: fighting mule accounts must balance risk control with business convenience; SMEs hit hard by scams
title.zh_hans: 金管局：打击傀儡户口要平衡风险与营商便利　中小企成骗案重灾区

summary.zh_hant: 金管局副總裁阮國恒表示，防騙工作並不只集中在個人層面，詐騙問題亦影響許多中小企；中小企較常收到假冒貿易對手方的電郵，被指示將資金轉帳至其他帳戶。他強調，在提供相關資料或資金之前，應先確認對方為真實對手、做好求證核實。阮國恒又指，防範傀儡戶口需要在風險防範與便利營商之間取得平衡。
summary.en: HKMA Deputy Chief Executive Arthur Yuen said anti-fraud work should not focus only on individuals, as scams also affect many small and medium-sized enterprises, which often receive emails impersonating trading counterparts instructing them to transfer funds to other accounts. He stressed that businesses should verify the other party is genuine before providing information or money. Yuen added that preventing mule accounts requires a balance between risk control and business convenience.
summary.zh_hans: 金管局副总裁阮国恒表示，防骗工作并不只集中在个人层面，诈骗问题亦影响许多中小企；中小企较常收到假冒贸易对手方的电邮，被指示将资金转帐至其他帐户。他强调，在提供相关资料或资金之前，应先确认对方为真实对手、做好求证核实。阮国恒又指，防范傀儡户口需要在风险防范与便利营商之间取得平衡。

title.zh_hant: 滬深股市半日齊跌　創業板挫逾3%　算力硬件股領跌
title.en: Shanghai and Shenzhen stocks fall at midday; ChiNext down over 3% as computing hardware shares lead losses
title.zh_hans: 沪深股市半日齐跌　创业板挫逾3%　算力硬件股领跌

summary.zh_hant: 內地股市半日跌逾1%至逾3%，算力硬件股下挫，CPO、貴金屬等股份亦向下；銀行、種植、電力股逆市上升。上證指數半日報3647點，跌42點，跌幅1.14%；深證成份指數報11216點，跌254點，跌幅2.22%；創業板指數報2477點。
summary.en: Mainland markets fell between more than 1 per cent and more than 3 per cent at midday, with computing hardware shares sliding and CPO and precious metals stocks also lower, while banks, farming and power stocks rose against the trend. The Shanghai Composite closed the morning at 3,647, down 42 points or 1.14 per cent; the Shenzhen Component Index was at 11,216, down 254 points or 2.22 per cent; and the ChiNext Index stood at 2,477.
summary.zh_hans: 内地股市半日跌逾1%至逾3%，算力硬件股下挫，CPO、贵金属等股份亦向下；银行、种植、电力股逆市上升。上证指数半日报3647点，跌42点，跌幅1.14%；深证成份指数报11216点，跌254点，跌幅2.22%；创业板指数报2477点。

title.zh_hant: 黃之鋒判囚10年　林定國：案件或有進一步發展　不宜在庭外多評論
title.en: Wong Chi-fung jailed for 10 years; Lam Ting-kwok says case may develop further and declines further comment outside court
title.zh_hans: 黄之锋判囚10年　林定国：案件或有进一步发展　不宜在庭外多评论

summary.zh_hant: 前香港眾志秘書長黃之鋒串謀勾結外國或者境外勢力危害國家安全，被法庭判囚10年。律政司司長林定國表示，由於案件的法律程序可能有進一步發展，作為律政司，不太適合在法庭外作太多評論。他強調，案件在整個過程中，包括被告是否得到公平審訊，以及整個法律程序，都是依據法治原則進行。
summary.en: Former Demosisto secretary-general Wong Chi-fung has been jailed for 10 years for conspiracy to collude with foreign or external forces to endanger national security. Secretary for Justice Lam Ting-kwok said the legal proceedings may develop further and, as Secretary for Justice, it would not be appropriate for him to comment extensively outside court. He stressed that throughout the case, including whether the defendant received a fair trial and the conduct of the legal process, everything was done in accordance with the rule of law.
summary.zh_hans: 前香港众志秘书长黄之锋串谋勾结外国或者境外势力危害国家安全，被法庭判囚10年。律政司司长林定国表示，由于案件的法律程序可能有进一步发展，作为律政司，不太适合在法庭外作太多评论。他强调，案件在整个过程中，包括被告是否得到公平审讯，以及整个法律程序，都是依据法治原则进行。

title.zh_hant: 下周一冷鋒殺到　周二周三市區跌至18度　新界更清涼
title.en: Cold front arrives Monday; city temperatures to fall to around 18°C on Tuesday and Wednesday
title.zh_hans: 下周一冷锋杀到　周二周三市区跌至18度　新界更清凉

summary.zh_hant: 天文台表示，一股達強風程度的東北季候風會在周末期間影響廣東沿岸，東風風勢頗大；預料一道冷鋒會在星期一初時橫過華南沿岸，隨後受強烈東北季候風影響，北風增強，氣溫顯著下降。星期二及星期三市區最低氣溫大約18度，新界天氣清涼。
summary.en: The Observatory says a strong northeasterly monsoon will affect the Guangdong coast over the weekend, with fresh to strong easterly winds, and a cold front is expected to cross the South China coast early on Monday. A strong northeasterly monsoon will then bring significantly lower temperatures, with minimum temperatures in urban areas of around 18 degrees Celsius on Tuesday and Wednesday, and cooler weather in the New Territories.
summary.zh_hans: 天文台表示，一股达强风程度的东北季候风会在周末期间影响广东沿岸，东风风势颇大；预料一道冷锋会在星期一初时横过华南沿岸，随后受强烈东北季候风影响，北风增强，气温显著下降。星期二及星期三市区最低气温大约18度，新界天气清凉。

title.zh_hant: 余偉文：今季市場繼續波動　外匯基金表現較困難　美元資產續減持
title.en: Eddie Yue: markets to stay volatile this quarter; Exchange Fund performance will remain difficult
title.zh_hans: 余伟文：今季市场继续波动　外汇基金表现较困难　美元资产续减持

summary.zh_hant: 金管局總裁余偉文表示，今季市場充滿不確定性，預計外匯基金今季表現仍會較困難。但他強調，投資市場每日變化很大，外匯基金需要用長期收益角度考慮整體資產配置，做好分散資產配置，包括地區和貨幣分散。余偉文表示，外匯基金的美元資產配置自去年底起逐步下調。
summary.en: HKMA Chief Executive Eddie Yue said markets remain full of uncertainty this quarter and the Exchange Fund's performance is expected to stay difficult. He stressed that markets change daily and the Fund must take a long-term view of returns, diversifying its asset allocation across regions and currencies. Yue said the Fund has been gradually reducing its US dollar asset allocation since the end of last year.
summary.zh_hans: 金管局总裁余伟文表示，今季市场充满不确定性，预计外汇基金今季表现仍会较困难。但他强调，投资市场每日变化很大，外汇基金需要用长期收益角度考虑整体资产配置，做好分散资产配置，包括地区和货币分散。余伟文表示，外汇基金的美元资产配置自去年底起逐步下调。

title.zh_hant: 金管局：北都院校及園區公司納入本地公營單位　融資成本有望降低
title.en: HKMA: treating Northern Metropolis institutions and park companies as local public sector entities will cut financing costs
title.zh_hans: 金管局：将北都院校及园区公司纳入本地公营单位　融资成本有望降低

summary.zh_hant: 金管局在立法會財經事務委員會會議上，提及支援實體經濟與北部都會區發展的措施。副總裁阮國恒表示，已成立專責分組探討公私營合作模式，並制定融資文件範本，令銀行可加快制定融資方案；北都金融諮詢工作小組短期內將舉行第3次會議。他說，正著手將11間北都專上院校與園區公司列為本地公營單位，有助降低融資成本。
summary.en: The HKMA told the Legislative Council's Panel on Financial Affairs about measures to support the real economy and the Northern Metropolis. Deputy Chief Executive Arthur Yuen said a dedicated group has been set up to explore public-private partnership models, with financing document templates drawn up so banks can prepare financing plans faster, and the Northern Metropolis financial advisory working group will hold its third meeting soon. He said work is under way to classify 11 post-secondary institutions and park companies in the Northern Metropolis as local public sector entities, which would help lower financing costs.
summary.zh_hans: 金管局在立法会财经事务委员会会议上，提及支持实体经济与北部都会区发展的措施。副总裁阮国恒表示，已成立专责分组探讨公私营合作模式，并制定融资文件范本，令银行可加快制定融资方案；北都金融咨询工作小组短期内将举行第3次会议。他说，正著手将11间北都专上院校与园区公司列为本地公营单位，有助降低融资成本。

title.zh_hant: 港台澄清與眾籌網站「FundHK」絕無關聯　籲市民提防假冒
title.en: RTHK clarifies it has no connection whatsoever with crowdfunding site 'FundHK'
title.zh_hans: 港台澄清与众筹网站「FundHK」绝无关联　吁市民提防假冒

summary.zh_hant: 香港電台表示，發現一個名為「FundHK」的眾籌網站，該網站在宣傳中使用「RTHK」字眼，並聲稱港台是其中一個「媒體及機構合作夥伴」。港台特此聲明，與該網站及其營運機構絕無任何形式的合作、夥伴關係或授權認可。
summary.en: RTHK says it has found a crowdfunding website called 'FundHK' which uses 'RTHK' in its publicity and claims RTHK is one of its 'media and institutional partners'. RTHK clarifies that it has no cooperation, partnership or endorsement of any kind with the website or its operator.
summary.zh_hans: 香港电台表示，发现一个名为「FundHK」的众筹网站，该网站在宣传中使用「RTHK」字眼，并声称港台是其中一个「媒体及机构合作伙伴」。港台特此声明，与该网站及其营运机构绝无任何形式的合作、伙伴关系或授权认可。

title.zh_hant: 金管局：銀行撥備覆蓋率高　盈利能力良好　信貸風險可控
title.en: HKMA: banks' provision coverage is high, profitability remains sound and credit risk is manageable
title.zh_hans: 金管局：银行拨备覆盖率高　盈利能力良好　信贷风险可控

summary.zh_hant: 金管局副總裁阮國恒表示，香港銀行特定分類貸款比率微跌，銀行撥備覆蓋率高，作出撥備後盈利能力仍然良好，認為信貸風險可控。他說，不會用現時情況去判定往後風險，強調仍有很多宏觀風險要處理。
summary.en: HKMA Deputy Chief Executive Arthur Yuen said Hong Kong banks' classified loan ratio edged down, provision coverage is high, and profitability after provisions remains sound, so credit risk is manageable. He said the current situation should not be used to judge future risks, stressing that many macroeconomic risks still need to be handled.
summary.zh_hans: 金管局副总裁阮国恒表示，香港银行特定分类贷款比率微跌，银行拨备覆盖率高，作出拨备后盈利能力仍然良好，认为信贷风险可控。他说，不会用现时情况去判定往后风险，强调仍有很多宏观风险要处理。

title.zh_hant: 進博會港企逾400間創新高　手工啤酒首參展搶內地市場　會計師行助內企出海
title.en: Record 400-plus Hong Kong firms at CIIE; craft beer brand makes debut eyeing mainland market
title.zh_hans: 进博会港企逾400间创新高　手工啤酒首参展抢内地市场　会计师行助内企出海

summary.zh_hant: 今屆進博會有超過400間香港企業參展，數目和規模創歷來新高。有參展港商期望透過進博會打入內地市場，其中本港手工啤酒品牌首次參展，帶來在港生產、於國際啤酒比賽獲獎的產品；公司市場總監蘇文潔說，香港市場相對細小，期望放眼內地市場。理工大學亦有參展，推廣科研成果；另外有參展的會計師行表示，會協助內地企業出海拓展業務。
summary.en: More than 400 Hong Kong enterprises are exhibiting at this year's China International Import Expo, a record in both number and scale. Exhibitors hope to use the expo to enter the mainland market, including a Hong Kong craft beer brand making its debut with locally brewed, internationally awarded products; its marketing director said the Hong Kong market is relatively small and the company is looking to the mainland. Hong Kong Polytechnic University is also exhibiting to promote its research, and an accounting firm at the expo said it helps mainland companies expand overseas.
summary.zh_hans: 今届进博会有超过400间香港企业参展，数目和规模创历来新高。有参展港商期望透过进博会打入内地市场，其中本港手工啤酒品牌首次参展，带来在港生产、于国际啤酒比赛获奖的产品；公司市场总监苏文洁说，香港市场相对细小，期望放眼内地市场。理工大学亦有参展，推广科研成果；另外有参展的会计师行表示，会协助内地企业出海拓展业务。

title.zh_hant: 電子交易修訂條例草案刊憲　提單匯票可數碼化　11月18日提交立法會
title.en: Electronic Transactions (Amendment) Bill gazetted: bills of lading and promissory notes can go digital; LegCo first reading on November 18
title.zh_hans: 电子交易修订条例草案刊宪　提单汇票可数码化　11月18日提交立法会

summary.zh_hant: 政府今日刊憲《2026年電子交易（修訂）條例草案》，旨在促進企業對企業貿易文件的數碼化，落實2025-26年度《財政預算案》及2025年《施政報告》的措施，以降低企業行政成本、提高貿易活動可追溯性。草案參考聯合國國際貿易法委員會《電子可轉讓記錄示範法》，為提單、匯票、承付票等可轉讓文件的數碼化提供與國際標準一致的法律框架，電子記錄與紙本具有功能等同效力，但只提供使用電子文件的選擇，不強制取代紙本。發言人指，已有13個司法管轄區制定以該示範法為藍本的法例，包括內地、法國、新加坡及英國；草案將於11月18日提交立法會首讀及二讀。
summary.en: The government today gazetted the Electronic Transactions (Amendment) Bill 2026, aimed at digitising business-to-business trade documents in line with the 2025-26 Budget and the 2025 Policy Address, to cut administrative costs and improve traceability. The bill follows the UNCITRAL Model Law on Electronic Transferable Records, giving digital versions of transferable documents such as bills of lading, bills of exchange and promissory notes the same legal effect as paper, while offering electronic records as an option rather than mandating them. Thirteen jurisdictions have already enacted laws based on the model law, including the mainland, France, Singapore and the United Kingdom; the bill will be introduced to the Legislative Council for first and second readings on November 18.
summary.zh_hans: 政府今日刊宪《2026年电子交易（修订）条例草案》，旨在促进企业对企业贸易文件的数码化，落实2025-26年度《财政预算案》及2025年《施政报告》的措施，以降低企业行政成本、提高贸易活动可追溯性。草案参考联合国国际贸易法委员会《电子可转让记录示范法》，为提单、汇票、承付票等可转让文件的数码化提供与国际标准一致的法律框架，电子记录与纸本具有功能等同效力，但只提供使用电子文件的选择，不强制取代纸本。发言人指，已有13个司法管辖区制定以该示范法为蓝本的法例，包括内地、法国、新加坡及英国；草案将于11月18日提交立法会首读及二读。

title.zh_hant: 兩小型工程承建商違規被罰　招牌工程未登記照做　除名兩個月兼罰款
title.en: Two minor works contractors disciplined over unregistered signboard works; struck off register for two months
title.zh_hans: 两小型工程承建商违规被罚　招牌工程未登记照做　除名两个月兼罚款

summary.zh_hant: 屋宇署宣布，註冊承建商紀律委員會完成兩宗根據《建築物條例》的紀律研訊，書面決定及命令於10月20日發出，今日刊憲。第一宗涉及元朗安寧路一間店舖的牆身招牌改動工程，承建商及其獲授權簽署人2022年12月提交證明書，聲稱已完成第III級別C類小型工程，但調查發現未有登記有關小型工程的種類及項目，卻進行及證明未登記的工程；承建商2024年8月在屯門裁判法院被定罪及罰款12,000元，委員會命令承建商由刊憲日起從名冊除名兩個月、獲授權簽署人罰款4,000元，兩者合共支付42,000元研訊費用。第二宗涉及筲箕灣道一幢大廈外牆豎設牆身招牌，2022年7月申報第II級別小型工程，但實際展示面積逾10平方米，應屬第I級別小型工程；承建商2024年5月在東區裁判法院被定罪及罰款16,000元，委員會命令承建商除名兩個月及罰款4,000元、獲授權簽署人兼董事罰款合共12,000元，兩者合共支付46,300元費用。
summary.en: The Buildings Department says the Registered Contractors' Disciplinary Board has completed two disciplinary inquiries under the Buildings Ordinance, with written decisions issued on October 20 and gazetted today. In the first case, a contractor and its authorised signatory submitted a certificate in December 2022 claiming completion of a Class III Category C minor works project for a wall sign alteration at a shop on On Ning Road, Yuen Long, but investigators found the type and item of minor works had never been registered, yet the works were carried out and certified; the contractor was convicted and fined HK$12,000 at Tuen Mun Magistrates' Courts in August 2024, and the board ordered the contractor removed from the register for two months, fined the signatory HK$4,000, and ordered both to pay HK$42,000 in inquiry costs. In the second case, a wall sign on a building on Shau Kei Wan Road was declared in July 2022 as Class II minor works, but its display area exceeded 10 square metres and should have been Class I; the contractor was convicted and fined HK$16,000 at Eastern Magistrates' Courts in May 2024, and the board ordered the contractor removed from the register for two months and fined HK$4,000, fined the signatory-cum-director a total of HK$12,000, and ordered both to pay HK$46,300 in costs.
summary.zh_hans: 屋宇署宣布，注册承建商纪律委员会完成两宗根据《建筑物条例》的纪律研讯，书面决定及命令于10月20日发出，今日刊宪。第一宗涉及元朗安宁路一间店铺的墙身招牌改动工程，承建商及其获授权签署人2022年12月提交证明书，声称已完成第III级别C类小型工程，但调查发现未有登记有关小型工程的种类及项目，却进行及证明未登记的工程；承建商2024年8月在屯门裁判法院被定罪及罚款12,000元，委员会命令承建商由刊宪日起从名册除名两个月、获授权签署人罚款4,000元，两者合共支付42,000元研讯费用。第二宗涉及筲箕湾道一幢大厦外墙竖设墙身招牌，2022年7月申报第II级别小型工程，但实际展示面积逾10平方米，应属第I级别小型工程；承建商2024年5月在东区裁判法院被定罪及罚款16,000元，委员会命令承建商除名两个月及罚款4,000元、获授权签署人兼董事罚款合共12,000元，两者合共支付46,300元费用。

title.zh_hant: 白宮否認防長國務卿或離職　特朗普：仍打算讓赫格塞思留任
title.en: White House denies defence secretary and secretary of state may quit; Trump says he still intends to keep Hegseth
title.zh_hans: 白宫否认防长国务卿或离职　特朗普：仍打算让赫格塞思留任

summary.zh_hant: 美國白宮否認有關國防部長赫格塞思與國務卿魯比奧可能離職的傳聞。美國傳媒報道，伊朗戰爭被認為是共和黨在中期選舉慘敗的原因之一，共和黨內部有人呼籲撤換赫格塞思，尤其不滿他處理戰事的方式，有共和黨國會議員威脅最快下星期發動彈劾投票。特朗普表示，仍打算讓赫格塞思留任。
summary.en: The White House has denied reports that Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth and Secretary of State Marco Rubio may leave office. US media reported that the Iran war is seen as one reason for the Republicans' heavy defeat in the midterm elections, with some in the party calling for Hegseth's removal, particularly over his handling of the war, and a Republican congressman threatening an impeachment vote as early as next week. President Trump said he still intends to keep Hegseth in his post.
summary.zh_hans: 美国白宫否认有关国防部长赫格塞思与国务卿鲁比奥可能离职的传闻。美国传媒报道，伊朗战争被认为是共和党在中期选举惨败的原因之一，共和党内部有人呼吁撤换赫格塞思，尤其不满他处理战事的方式，有共和党国会议员威胁最快下星期发动弹劾投票。特朗普表示，仍打算让赫格塞思留任。

title.zh_hant: 郵政公布明年上半年新郵票　羊年生肖＋北都＋國安教育　六枚通用郵票有啟德體育園
title.en: Hongkong Post unveils new stamps for first half of 2027: Year of the Ram, Northern Metropolis and national security education issues; six new definitive stamps feature Kai Tak Sports Park
title.zh_hans: 邮政公布明年上半年新邮票　羊年生肖＋北都＋国安教育　六枚通用邮票有启德体育园

summary.zh_hant: 香港郵政公布，2027年1月至6月將發行一套新面額香港通用郵票及五套不同主題的特別郵票。新通用郵票共六枚，設計沿用「2025年香港通用郵票」，以啟德體育園、香港夜景、香港國際機場三跑道系統、獅子山、山頂凌霄閣及沙螺洞等地標，展示香港的活力與文化。五套特別郵票包括迎接2027年羊年的農曆新年生肖郵票、北部都會區、全民國家安全教育、香港公共房屋發展II，以及作為系列終結篇的香港遠足徑第4號港島徑；中國郵政、香港郵政及澳門郵電亦會聯合推出羊年紀念套摺。上述新郵品即日起可於網上平台預訂，11月23日前訂購可獲贈品及積分。
summary.en: Hongkong Post has announced that it will issue a set of Hong Kong definitive stamps with new denominations and five sets of special stamps between January and June 2027. The six new definitive stamps follow the design of the 2025 definitive stamps, featuring landmarks including Kai Tak Sports Park, the Hong Kong night view, the Three-Runway System of Hong Kong International Airport, Lion Rock, the Peak Tower and Sha Lo Tung. The five special stamp sets cover the Year of the Ram lunar new year issue, the Northern Metropolis, national security education, the development of public housing in Hong Kong II, and the Hong Kong Trail as the finale of the hiking trails series; China Post, Hongkong Post and Macao Post will also jointly present a Year of the Ram souvenir pack. Advance orders open today, with gifts and bonus points for orders placed by November 23.
summary.zh_hans: 香港邮政公布，2027年1月至6月将发行一套新面额香港通用邮票及五套不同主题的特别邮票。新通用邮票共六枚，设计沿用「2025年香港通用邮票」，以启德体育园、香港夜景、香港国际机场三跑道系统、狮子山、山顶凌霄阁及沙螺洞等地标，展示香港的活力与文化。五套特别邮票包括迎接2027年羊年的农历新年生肖邮票、北部都会区、全民国家安全教育、香港公共房屋发展II，以及作为系列终结篇的香港远足径第4号港岛径；中国邮政、香港邮政及澳门邮电亦会联合推出羊年纪念套摺。上述新邮品即日起可于网上平台预订，11月23日前订购可获赠品及积分。

title.zh_hant: 「智安存」截至9月吸5.8萬客鎖近100億　金管局：28間銀行資訊交換量暴增14倍
title.en: HKMA's 'Smart Deposit' protection draws 58,000 customers locking in nearly HK$10 billion; interbank information sharing up 14-fold across 28 banks
title.zh_hans: 「智安存」截至9月吸5.8万客锁近100亿　金管局：28间银行资讯交换量暴增14倍

summary.zh_hant: 金管局副總裁阮國恒表示，全港28間零售銀行已加入銀行間訊息交換平台，資訊交換量暴增14倍。去年底推出的客戶保障「智安存」截至9月已有5.8萬名香港客戶使用，鎖起部分存款不允許網上轉帳，涉及金額近100億元。在立法會財經事務委員會會議上，有議員關注市民信用卡被盜用訂購新手機，主要由於商戶未有採用3D Secure驗證碼工具。阮國恒指出，3DS2是信用卡網絡營運商提供的保安安排，目前全球各地皆採用統一做法，決定權交由商戶決定；如果商戶決定不使用，相關損失由商戶承擔。金管局已持續接觸信用卡網絡營運商及商戶，期望採用有3DS2保安安排；至於市民可否自主決定是否使用，阮國恒說要再與營運商商討，因為全球都無相關做法。
summary.en: HKMA deputy chief executive Arthur Yuen said all 28 retail banks in Hong Kong have joined an interbank information exchange platform, with the volume of information shared surging 14-fold. The customer protection scheme "Smart Deposit", launched at the end of last year, had 58,000 Hong Kong customers as of September, locking nearly HK$10 billion in deposits so they cannot be transferred online. At a Legislative Council finance committee meeting, lawmakers raised concerns about credit cards being stolen to buy new phones, mainly because merchants do not use 3D Secure verification. Yuen said 3DS2 is a security arrangement provided by card network operators and the decision rests with merchants under a uniform global practice; if a merchant opts out, the merchant bears the loss. The HKMA is engaging card networks and merchants to promote 3DS2, and will discuss with operators whether customers can choose to use it themselves, as no such practice exists globally.
summary.zh_hans: 金管局副总裁阮国恒表示，全港28间零售银行已加入银行间讯息交换平台，资讯交换量暴增14倍。去年底推出的客户保障「智安存」截至9月已有5.8万名香港客户使用，锁起部分存款不允许网上转帐，涉及金额近100亿元。在立法会财经事务委员会会议上，有议员关注市民信用卡被盗用订购新手机，主要由于商户未有采用3D Secure验证码工具。阮国恒指出，3DS2是信用卡网络营运商提供的保安安排，目前全球各地皆采用统一做法，决定权交由商户决定；如果商户决定不使用，相关损失由商户承担。金管局已持续接触信用卡网络营运商及商户，期望采用有3DS2保安安排；至于市民可否自主决定是否使用，阮国恒说要再与营运商商讨，因为全球都无相关做法。

title.zh_hant: 前中醫藥管理局局長余艷紅涉嚴重違紀違法　主動投案受查　剛被撤政協委員資格
title.en: Former traditional Chinese medicine chief Yu Yanhong under investigation for serious discipline violations after turning herself in; CPPCC membership just revoked
title.zh_hans: 前中医药管理局局长余艳红涉严重违纪违法　主动投案受查　刚被撤政协委员资格

summary.zh_hant: 新華社報道，國家衛健委原黨組成員，國家中醫藥管理局原黨組書記、局長余艷紅涉嫌嚴重違紀違法，主動投案，目前正接受中紀委國監委紀律審查和監察調查。現年64歲的余艷紅是湖南邵陽人，曾任南方醫科大學校長、廣東省副省長，2018年起調往衛健委和中醫藥管理局任職，並曾兼任全國婦聯副主席。余艷紅是十四屆全國政協委員，在剛過去的星期三被撤銷委員資格。
summary.en: Xinhua reported that Yu Yanhong, a former member of the National Health Commission's party group and former party secretary and director of the National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine, is suspected of serious violations of discipline and law. She turned herself in and is under disciplinary review and supervisory investigation by the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and the National Supervisory Commission. Yu, 64, is from Shaoyang in Hunan. She served as president of Southern Medical University and vice-governor of Guangdong, moved to the National Health Commission and the traditional Chinese medicine administration in 2018, and was a vice-chairwoman of the All-China Women's Federation. She was a member of the 14th CPPCC National Committee, and her membership was revoked on Wednesday.
summary.zh_hans: 新华社报道，国家卫健委原党组成员，国家中医药管理局原党组书记、局长余艳红涉嫌严重违纪违法，主动投案，目前正接受中纪委国监委纪律审查和监察调查。现年64岁的余艳红是湖南邵阳人，曾任南方医科大学校长、广东省副省长，2018年起调往卫健委和中医药管理局任职，并曾兼任全国妇联副主席。余艳红是十四届全国政协委员，在刚过去的星期三被撤销委员资格。

title.zh_hant: 查冊新制9大指定目的　私隱專員：保障業主防起底　今年已接6宗濫用投訴
title.en: New land search rules set nine specified purposes; privacy chief says they protect owners from doxxing as six misuse complaints already filed this year
title.zh_hans: 查册新制9大指定目的　私隐专员：保障业主防起底　今年已接6宗滥用投诉

summary.zh_hant: 政府上月公布8條有關業權註冊制度的附屬法例，查冊須符合指定目的，並有9項指定目的。個人資料私隱專員鍾麗玲在本台節目《千禧年代》表示，新安排令查冊制度清晰化，從保障個人資料私隱角度來看，除了更能保障業主私隱、亦便利相關部門處理查冊，以及避免查冊人誤墮法網，達到三方面共贏。她說，新安排列明9項指定目的，包括物業交易、對土地或物業作出估價等，都是很具體及清晰，可以令查冊人清楚知道自己是基於甚麼目的索取有關資料，以及在索取得到有關資料後，要用在相關目的，不能濫用。鍾麗玲又說，過去5年公署共接獲20宗涉嫌濫用土地登記冊資料的投訴，當中包括在土地登記冊索取到資料後，向相關業主「起底」上載到社交平台，亦有投訴涉及土地登記冊資料被索取後，業主收到促銷信件；公署單是今年就收到6宗相關投訴，情況有惡化跡象。她表示，根據《個人資料（私隱）條例》第61條，為新聞活動使用個人資料提供豁免，但前提是需要符合公眾利益；今次當局的新安排亦包括查冊目的是為符合公眾利益，兩者的前提都是需要符合公眾利益。
summary.en: The government announced eight pieces of subsidiary legislation on the title registration system last month, under which land searches must serve one of nine specified purposes. Privacy Commissioner Chung Lai-ling told RTHK's Millennium programme that the new arrangement clarifies the search system: it better protects owners' privacy, helps departments handle searches and prevents searchers from inadvertently breaking the law — a win on all three fronts. The nine specified purposes, including property transactions and land or property valuations, are specific and clear, so searchers know why they are obtaining the information and must use it only for that purpose. Chung said the commission received 20 complaints over the past five years about misuse of Land Registry data, including cases where owners were doxxed on social media after their details were obtained, and cases where owners received sales letters; six complaints have already been received this year, a worsening trend. She added that section 61 of the Personal Data (Privacy) Ordinance exempts the use of personal data for news activities if it serves the public interest, and the new arrangement likewise requires searches to serve the public interest.
summary.zh_hans: 政府上月公布8条有关业权注册制度的附属法例，查册须符合指定目的，并有9项指定目的。个人资料私隐专员钟丽玲在本台节目《千禧年代》表示，新安排令查册制度清晰化，从保障个人资料私隐角度来看，除了更能保障业主私隐、亦便利相关部门处理查册，以及避免查册人误堕法网，达到三方面共赢。她说，新安排列明9项指定目的，包括物业交易、对土地或物业作出估价等，都是很具体及清晰，可以令查册人清楚知道自己是基于甚么目的索取有关资料，以及在索取得到有关资料后，要用在相关目的，不能滥用。钟丽玲又说，过去5年公署共接获20宗涉嫌滥用土地登记册资料的投诉，当中包括在土地登记册索取到资料后，向相关业主「起底」上载到社交平台，亦有投诉涉及土地登记册资料被索取后，业主收到促销信件；公署单是今年就收到6宗相关投诉，情况有恶化迹象。她表示，根据《个人资料（私隐）条例》第61条，为新闻活动使用个人资料提供豁免，但前提是需要符合公众利益；今次当局的新安排亦包括查册目的是为符合公众利益，两者的前提都是需要符合公众利益。

title.zh_hant: 金管局：銀行存貸首9個月齊升7.7%　貿易融資勁增兩成　對銀行穩定性有信心
title.en: HKMA: bank deposits and loans both up 7.7% in first nine months, trade finance jumps 20%; confident in banking stability
title.zh_hans: 金管局：银行存贷首9个月齐升7.7%　贸易融资劲增两成　对银行稳定性有信心

summary.zh_hant: 金管局副總裁阮國恒表示，今年首9個月，銀行總體存款及貸款均升7.7%，年率化亦分別超過10%及10.2%。本地及境外使用的貸款及貿易融資都增加迅速，其中貿易融資首9個月增長20%。銀行業資本水平、流動性比率及盈利能力參數均表現良好，對銀行穩定性有信心。他說，第3季特定分類貸款比率初步數字與第2季末維持平穩。銀行撥備水平充足，不計抵押品撥備覆蓋率約65%，計及抵押品變現價值後撥備覆蓋率達150%，認為目前信貸風險整體可控。
summary.en: HKMA deputy chief executive Arthur Yuen said total bank deposits and loans both rose 7.7% in the first nine months of the year, with annualised growth of more than 10% and 10.2% respectively. Loans for use in Hong Kong and overseas, as well as trade finance, grew rapidly, with trade finance up 20% in the first nine months. Banks' capital levels, liquidity ratios and profitability are all performing well, and he is confident in the stability of the banking sector. Yuen said the classified loan ratio in the third quarter was initially steady versus the end of the second quarter. Provisions are adequate, with a coverage ratio of about 65% excluding collateral and 150% including the realisable value of collateral, and overall credit risk is controllable.
summary.zh_hans: 金管局副总裁阮国恒表示，今年首9个月，银行总体存款及贷款均升7.7%，年率化亦分别超过10%及10.2%。本地及境外使用的贷款及贸易融资都增加迅速，其中贸易融资首9个月增长20%。银行业资本水平、流动性比率及盈利能力参数均表现良好，对银行稳定性有信心。他说，第3季特定分类贷款比率初步数字与第2季末维持平稳。银行拨备水平充足，不计抵押品拨备覆盖率约65%，计及抵押品变现价值后拨备覆盖率达150%，认为目前信贷风险整体可控。

title.zh_hant: 巴拉圭總統辭職未果留任　國會人數不足投票流產　眾議院啟動彈劾程序
title.en: Paraguay president stays in office as resignation vote fails for lack of quorum; lower house launches impeachment proceedings
title.zh_hans: 巴拉圭总统辞职未果留任　国会人数不足投票流产　众议院启动弹劾程序

summary.zh_hant: 巴拉圭全國最大數字銀行韋諾銀行被中央銀行接管，觸發政治危機。曾經是銀行股東的總統培尼亞星期四上午宣布辭職，但由於國會投票人數不足，暫未通過他的辭呈，培尼亞暫時留任，國會隨後啟動對他的彈劾程序。培尼亞的辭呈只有在國會投票通過後才能生效，但由於投票期間培尼亞所屬的科羅拉多黨議員陸續離席，導致會議人數不足法定人數，投票被迫中止。眾議院同日上午通過啟動對培尼亞的彈劾程序。根據憲法，總統如果是自己辭職而非被彈劾，可享有終身參議員的特權，如果被彈劾就會失去豁免權。巴拉圭中央銀行星期二表示，管理約8億5000萬美元國家公共資金的韋諾銀行違反最低償付能力要求，宣布展開清算接管程序，事件導致用戶無法提款，民眾上街抗議，要求全額退還資金及培尼亞辭職。培尼亞較早時發布影片，宣布辭職的決定，強調此舉旨在維護國家穩定、社會和平及民主制度，又說會與有關機構充分合作，查明真相，明確責任，並將違法者繩之以法。
summary.en: Paraguay's largest digital bank, Ueno Bank, was taken over by the central bank, triggering a political crisis. President Santiago Peña, a former shareholder of the bank, announced his resignation on Thursday morning, but Congress did not have enough members present to vote on it, so the resignation has not taken effect and Peña remains in office for now, while Congress has launched impeachment proceedings against him. A presidential resignation only takes effect after a congressional vote, but Colorado Party lawmakers — Peña's own party — left the chamber during the vote, leaving it short of a quorum and forcing the vote to be abandoned. The Chamber of Deputies passed a motion on Thursday morning to start impeachment proceedings. Under the constitution, a president who resigns rather than being impeached enjoys the privilege of a lifetime senator; if impeached, he loses immunity. The central bank said on Tuesday that Ueno Bank, which manages about US$850 million in public funds, had breached minimum solvency requirements and announced liquidation and takeover proceedings; users have been unable to withdraw money and people have taken to the streets demanding full refunds and Peña's resignation. Peña earlier released a video announcing his resignation, saying it was aimed at safeguarding national stability, social peace and democracy, and that he would cooperate fully with the relevant bodies to establish the truth and hold wrongdoers accountable.
summary.zh_hans: 巴拉圭全国最大数字银行韦诺银行被中央银行接管，触发政治危机。曾经是银行股东的总统培尼亚星期四上午宣布辞职，但由于国会投票人数不足，暂未通过他的辞呈，培尼亚暂时留任，国会随后启动对他的弹劾程序。培尼亚的辞呈只有在国会投票通过后才能生效，但由于投票期间培尼亚所属的科罗拉多党议员陆续离席，导致会议人数不足法定人数，投票被迫中止。众议院同日上午通过启动对培尼亚的弹劾程序。根据宪法，总统如果是自己辞职而非被弹劾，可享有终身参议员的特权，如果被弹劾就会失去豁免权。巴拉圭中央银行星期二表示，管理约8亿5000万美元国家公共资金的韦诺银行违反最低偿付能力要求，宣布展开清算接管程序，事件导致用户无法提款，民众上街抗议，要求全额退还资金及培尼亚辞职。培尼亚较早时发布影片，宣布辞职的决定，强调此举旨在维护国家稳定、社会和平及民主制度，又说会与有关机构充分合作，查明真相，明确责任，并将违法者绳之以法。

title.zh_hant: 全國人大常委會通過反跨境腐敗法　6章47條即日施行　深化反腐國際合作
title.en: China's top legislature passes anti-cross-border corruption law, effective immediately, to deepen international anti-corruption cooperation
title.zh_hans: 全国人大常委会通过反跨境腐败法　6章47条即日施行　深化反腐国际合作

summary.zh_hant: 十四屆全國人大常委會第二十五次會議表決通過反跨境腐敗法，該法自公布之日起施行。新華社報道，反跨境腐敗法共6章47條，包括機制和職責、案件辦理和國際合作、廉潔合規、法律責任等內容。報道稱，制定反跨境腐敗法是為了預防和懲治跨境腐敗行為，深化反腐敗國際合作，維護國家主權、安全、發展利益，推動構建公正合理的反腐敗全球治理體系。
summary.en: The 25th session of the Standing Committee of the 14th National People's Congress has voted to pass the Anti-Cross-Border Corruption Law, which takes effect from the date of promulgation. Xinhua reported that the law has six chapters and 47 articles, covering mechanisms and responsibilities, case handling and international cooperation, integrity and compliance, and legal liability. The law aims to prevent and punish cross-border corruption, deepen international anti-corruption cooperation, safeguard national sovereignty, security and development interests, and promote a fair and reasonable global anti-corruption governance system.
summary.zh_hans: 十四届全国人大常委会第二十五次会议表决通过反跨境腐败法，该法自公布之日起施行。新华社报道，反跨境腐败法共6章47条，包括机制和职责、案件办理和国际合作、廉洁合规、法律责任等内容。报道称，制定反跨境腐败法是为了预防和惩治跨境腐败行为，深化反腐败国际合作，维护国家主权、安全、发展利益，推动构建公正合理的反腐败全球治理体系。

title.zh_hant: 金管局總裁：環球兩大風險——能源價升＋AI投資　港IPO集資逾3800億全球第二
title.en: HKMA chief names two global risks — rising energy prices and AI investment — as Hong Kong IPO fundraising tops HK$380 billion, second in the world
title.zh_hans: 金管局总裁：环球两大风险——能源价升＋AI投资　港IPO集资逾3800亿全球第二

summary.zh_hant: 金管局總裁余偉文表示，香港第3季經濟增長5.2%，投資、消費都有增長。截至10月底，新股上市融資額已較去年全年多1.4倍，逾3800億元，位列環球第二，交投平穩。余偉文在立法會財經事務委員會會議上指，環球貨幣狀況持續收緊，美國9月加息，市場預期12月或明年初或會再加，近幾個月美元轉強，使用美元的企業融資成本上升。他提出環球有兩個風險點，包括能源價格上升以及人工智能相關投資，提到因美國中期選舉，AI股份昨晚出現相當大回落。他提到，內地第3季經濟回升，稍為好過預期，出口強勁，但投資較前兩季回落，消費則反彈。內地亦加大政策力度，包括新增地方政府專項貸款，以及推出新的政策性工具。他又指，港元匯率已回落至偏向弱方兌換保證水平，因港美息差超過100點子，存在套息空間，股票市場相關的港元需求亦稍為降低，但仍然屬正常現象，整體市場暢順運作。余偉文說，樓價第三季輕微回落0.8%，交投亦減至1.3萬多宗，因市場存在很多不明朗因素，包括利率及中東局勢未明。
summary.en: HKMA chief executive Eddie Yue said Hong Kong's economy grew 5.2% in the third quarter, with both investment and consumption rising. IPO fundraising by the end of October had already exceeded last year's full-year total by 1.4 times, topping HK$380 billion and ranking second in the world, with trading stable. Speaking at a Legislative Council finance committee meeting, Yue said global monetary conditions keep tightening: the US raised rates in September and the market expects a possible further hike in December or early next year, while the dollar has strengthened in recent months, raising financing costs for companies using US dollars. He flagged two global risk points — rising energy prices and AI-related investment — noting that AI stocks fell sharply last night after the US midterm elections. On the mainland, third-quarter growth rebounded slightly better than expected, with strong exports, investment easing from the first two quarters and consumption recovering; Beijing has stepped up policy support, including new local government special bonds and new policy tools. Yue added that the Hong Kong dollar has eased towards the weak-side convertibility undertaking as the Hong Kong-US interest rate gap exceeds 100 basis points, creating room for carry trades, while stock-market-related Hong Kong dollar demand has eased slightly but remains normal, with markets operating smoothly. Property prices edged down 0.8% in the third quarter and transactions fell to just over 13,000, amid many uncertainties including interest rates and the Middle East.
summary.zh_hans: 金管局总裁余伟文表示，香港第3季经济增长5.2%，投资、消费都有增长。截至10月底，新股上市融资额已较去年全年多1.4倍，逾3800亿元，位列环球第二，交投平稳。余伟文在立法会财经事务委员会会议上指，环球货币状况持续收紧，美国9月加息，市场预期12月或明年初或会再加，近几个月美元转强，使用美元的企业融资成本上升。他提出环球有两个风险点，包括能源价格上升以及人工智能相关投资，提到因美国中期选举，AI股份昨晚出现相当大回落。他提到，内地第3季经济回升，稍为好过预期，出口强劲，但投资较前两季回落，消费则反弹。内地亦加大政策力度，包括新增地方政府专项贷款，以及推出新的政策性工具。他又指，港元汇率已回落至偏向弱方兑换保证水平，因港美息差超过100点子，存在套息空间，股票市场相关的港元需求亦稍为降低，但仍然属正常现象，整体市场畅顺运作。余伟文说，楼价第三季轻微回落0.8%，交投亦减至1.3万多宗，因市场存在很多不明朗因素，包括利率及中东局势未明。

title.zh_hant: 人行本周淨回籠15230億　創3個月單周新高　連續5日收水
title.en: PBOC drains a net 1.523 trillion yuan this week, the largest weekly withdrawal in three months, for a fifth straight day
title.zh_hans: 人行本周净回笼15230亿　创3个月单周新高　连续5日收水

summary.zh_hant: 人民銀行公開市場進行2260億元人民幣隔夜逆回購操作，利率維持1.25厘。公開市場單日淨回籠520億元，連續5日淨回籠，本周累計淨回籠15230億元，單星期創3個月淨回籠規模新高。
summary.en: The People's Bank of China conducted 226 billion yuan of overnight reverse repo operations in the open market, with the interest rate unchanged at 1.25%. The open market recorded a net withdrawal of 52 billion yuan for the day, the fifth consecutive day of net withdrawals, bringing the weekly cumulative net withdrawal to 1.523 trillion yuan — the largest single-week net withdrawal in three months.
summary.zh_hans: 人民银行公开市场进行2260亿元人民币隔夜逆回购操作，利率维持1.25厘。公开市场单日净回笼520亿元，连续5日净回笼，本周累计净回笼15230亿元，单星期创3个月净回笼规模新高。

title.zh_hant: 以色列反對派正直黨拒與內塔尼亞胡聯合執政　挺埃森科特組閣席位達67席過半
title.en: Israel's opposition Yeshar party refuses to govern with Netanyahu as parties backing Eisenkot reach 67 seats, a majority
title.zh_hans: 以色列反对派正直党拒与内塔尼亚胡联合执政　挺埃森科特组阁席位达67席过半

summary.zh_hant: 以色列國防軍前總參謀長埃森科特領導的正直黨代表，星期四與總統赫爾佐格會面時表示，認同反對派陣營共同原則的政黨，有機會加入聯盟，同時表明拒絕與總理內塔尼亞胡聯合執政。以色列阿拉伯裔政黨聯盟「聯合名單」發表聲明，表示會向赫爾佐格提議，授權埃森科特組建新政府。目前已表態支持埃森科特組閣的政黨，在議會的議席達到過半數的67席。內塔尼亞胡陣營的長期盟友、聖經猶太教聯盟黨代表，星期四在與赫爾佐格的會面中，未有推薦內塔尼亞胡組建新政府。有評論認為，這為該黨未來與埃森科特組建聯合政府創造可能。
summary.en: Representatives of the Yeshar party, led by former Israel Defense Forces chief of staff Gadi Eisenkot, told President Isaac Herzog on Thursday that parties sharing the opposition camp's common principles could join a coalition, while making clear they refuse to govern jointly with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. The Joint List, an alliance of Israeli Arab parties, said it would propose to Herzog that Eisenkot be mandated to form a new government. Parties that have declared support for Eisenkot now hold 67 seats in parliament, more than half. Representatives of United Torah Judaism, a long-time ally of Netanyahu's camp, did not recommend Netanyahu to form a government in their meeting with Herzog on Thursday. Commentators say this opens the possibility of the party joining a future coalition with Eisenkot.
summary.zh_hans: 以色列国防军前总参谋长埃森科特领导的正直党代表，星期四与总统赫尔佐格会面时表示，认同反对派阵营共同原则的政党，有机会加入联盟，同时表明拒绝与总理内塔尼亚胡联合执政。以色列阿拉伯裔政党联盟「联合名单」发表声明，表示会向赫尔佐格提议，授权埃森科特组建新政府。目前已表态支持埃森科特组阁的政党，在议会的议席达到过半数的67席。内塔尼亚胡阵营的长期盟友、圣经犹太教联盟党代表，星期四在与赫尔佐格的会面中，未有推荐内塔尼亚胡组建新政府。有评论认为，这为该党未来与埃森科特组建联合政府创造可能。

title.zh_hant: 外匯基金第3季賺186億　首9個月賺1719億　債券收入僅3億暴跌99%
title.en: Exchange Fund earns HK$18.6 billion in Q3 and HK$171.9 billion in first nine months; bond income collapses 99% to just HK$300 million
title.zh_hans: 外汇基金第3季赚186亿　首9个月赚1719亿　债券收入仅3亿暴跌99%

summary.zh_hant: 金管局公布，外匯基金第3季未計其他投資，錄得投資收入186億元，首3季投資收入1719億元。第3季各項投資都賺，但債券投資收入只得3億元，按年及按季都跌約99%。港股投資收入91億元，按年跌47%。其他股票投資收入15億元，按年及按季都跌逾90%。外匯投資賺77億元，去年同期虧損266億元，按季則跌8%。至於首3季各項投資，只得港股投資虧損27億元，其餘都錄得投資收入。
summary.en: The HKMA announced that the Exchange Fund recorded investment income of HK$18.6 billion in the third quarter, excluding other investments, and HK$171.9 billion in the first nine months. All investments made money in the third quarter, but bond investment income was only HK$300 million, down about 99% year on year and quarter on quarter. Hong Kong stocks generated HK$9.1 billion, down 47% year on year. Other equities earned HK$1.5 billion, down more than 90% year on year and quarter on quarter. Foreign exchange investments earned HK$7.7 billion, against a loss of HK$26.6 billion in the same period last year, and down 8% quarter on quarter. For the first nine months, only Hong Kong stock investments lost money, down HK$2.7 billion, with all other investments profitable.
summary.zh_hans: 金管局公布，外汇基金第3季未计其他投资，录得投资收入186亿元，首3季投资收入1719亿元。第3季各项投资都赚，但债券投资收入只得3亿元，按年及按季都跌约99%。港股投资收入91亿元，按年跌47%。其他股票投资收入15亿元，按年及按季都跌逾90%。外汇投资赚77亿元，去年同期亏损266亿元，按季则跌8%。至于首3季各项投资，只得港股投资亏损27亿元，其余都录得投资收入。

title.zh_hant: 特朗普：非常接近解決俄烏問題　重大協議範圍或覆蓋整個歐洲
title.en: Trump says a resolution to the Russia-Ukraine war is very close, with a major deal that could cover all of Europe
title.zh_hans: 特朗普：非常接近解决俄乌问题　重大协议范围或覆盖整个欧洲

summary.zh_hant: 美俄烏下星期在阿聯酋舉行三方會談前，美國第一夫人梅拉尼婭星期四在白宮與俄烏代表會面，呼籲雙方以日前實施停火的奧列什基為起點，合作實現更持久的和平。總統特朗普透露，在白宮會見了俄羅斯總統特別代表德米特里耶夫，但沒有會見烏克蘭代表。他認為距離解決俄烏問題已經非常接近，將會就俄烏問題達成重大協議，協議涉及的範圍亦不限於烏克蘭，甚至可能涵蓋整個歐洲。特朗普的女婿庫什納就在社交媒體發文說，美國與烏克蘭、北約及歐洲伙伴星期四在布魯塞爾進行了富有成效，而且實質性的討論，議題涉及對烏克蘭的安全保障，以及更廣泛的歐洲安全架構。
summary.en: Ahead of US-Russia-Ukraine trilateral talks in the United Arab Emirates next week, US First Lady Melania Trump met Russian and Ukrainian representatives at the White House on Thursday, urging both sides to use the ceasefire implemented days ago in Oleshky as a starting point for a more lasting peace. President Donald Trump said he met Russian presidential special representative Kirill Dmitriev at the White House, but did not meet the Ukrainian representative. He believes a resolution to the Russia-Ukraine issue is very close and that a major agreement will be reached, with a scope not limited to Ukraine and possibly covering all of Europe. Trump's son-in-law Jared Kushner posted on social media that the US held productive and substantive discussions with Ukraine, NATO and European partners in Brussels on Thursday, covering security guarantees for Ukraine and the broader European security architecture.
summary.zh_hans: 美俄乌下星期在阿联酋举行三方会谈前，美国第一夫人梅拉尼娅星期四在白宫与俄乌代表会面，呼吁双方以日前实施停火的奥列什基为起点，合作实现更持久的和平。总统特朗普透露，在白宫会见了俄罗斯总统特别代表德米特里耶夫，但没有会见乌克兰代表。他认为距离解决俄乌问题已经非常接近，将会就俄乌问题达成重大协议，协议涉及的范围亦不限于乌克兰，甚至可能覆盖整个欧洲。特朗普的女婿库什纳就在社交媒体发文说，美国与乌克兰、北约及欧洲伙伴星期四在布鲁塞尔进行了富有成效，而且实质性的讨论，议题涉及对乌克兰的安全保障，以及更广泛的欧洲安全架构。

title.zh_hant: 台股跟隨美日韓急挫　初段暴跌近9%　失3730點報37844點
title.en: Taiwan stocks follow US, Japanese and Korean markets sharply lower, plunging nearly 9% in early trade to 37,844
title.zh_hans: 台股跟随美日韩急挫　初段暴跌近9%　失3730点报37844点

summary.zh_hant: 台股跟隨美日韓股市急挫，加權指數較早時報37844點，跌3730點，跌幅8.97%。
summary.en: Taiwan stocks followed the sharp falls in US, Japanese and South Korean markets, with the weighted index trading at 37,844 earlier, down 3,730 points or 8.97%.
summary.zh_hans: 台股跟随美日韩股市急挫，加权指数较早时报37844点，跌3730点，跌幅8.97%。

title.zh_hant: 巴拉圭銀行危機引爆政壇地震　總統培尼亞宣布辭職　眾議院同日通過彈劾
title.en: Paraguay president Peña resigns as bank takeover sparks political crisis; lower house passes impeachment the same day
title.zh_hans: 巴拉圭银行危机引爆政坛地震　总统培尼亚宣布辞职　众议院同日通过弹劾

summary.zh_hant: 巴拉圭全國最大數字銀行韋諾銀行被中央銀行接管，觸發政治危機。央行星期二表示，管理約8億5000萬美元國家公共資金的韋諾銀行違反最低償付能力要求，宣布展開清算接管程序。韋諾銀行在當地擁有約300萬客戶，佔全國三分二成年人口，事件令用戶無法提款，民眾上街抗議並與警方衝突。曾經是銀行股東的總統培尼亞被反對派指責利益衝突，在失去所屬科羅拉多黨支持後宣布辭職；眾議院同日召開特別會議，通過對他的彈劾指控，培尼亞表示將出席參議院彈劾聽證會行使辯護權。
summary.en: Paraguay's largest digital bank, Ueno Bank, was taken over by the central bank, triggering a political crisis. The central bank said on Tuesday that Ueno Bank, which manages about US$850 million in public funds, had breached minimum solvency requirements and announced liquidation and takeover proceedings. The bank has about three million customers in the country — two-thirds of the adult population — and the takeover left users unable to withdraw money, prompting street protests that clashed with police. President Santiago Peña, a former shareholder of the bank, was accused by the opposition of a conflict of interest and resigned after losing the support of his Colorado Party; the Chamber of Deputies held a special session the same day and passed impeachment charges against him. Peña said he would attend the Senate impeachment hearing to exercise his right of defence.
summary.zh_hans: 巴拉圭全国最大数字银行韦诺银行被中央银行接管，触发政治危机。央行星期二表示，管理约8亿5000万美元国家公共资金的韦诺银行违反最低偿付能力要求，宣布展开清算接管程序。韦诺银行在当地拥有约300万客户，占全国三分二成年人口，事件令用户无法提款，民众上街抗议并与警方冲突。曾经是银行股东的总统培尼亚被反对派指责利益冲突，在失去所属科罗拉多党支持后宣布辞职；众议院同日召开特别会议，通过对他的弹劾指控，培尼亚表示将出席参议院弹劾听证会行使辩护权。

title.zh_hant: 韓股暴瀉8.55%觸發熔斷　失守5000點　日股跌近4%失守6萬點
title.en: South Korean stocks plunge 8.55% triggering a circuit breaker and falling below 5,000; Japanese shares drop nearly 4% below 60,000
title.zh_hans: 韩股暴泻8.55%触发熔断　失守5000点　日股跌近4%失守6万点

summary.zh_hant: 日韓股市今早初段急挫，韓股觸發熔斷機制，暫停交易20分鐘。首爾綜合指數跌穿5000點關口，開市後報4923點，跌460點，跌幅8.55%。日經指數亦失守6萬點關口，較早時報58906點，跌2171點，跌幅3.55%。
summary.en: Japanese and South Korean stock markets plunged in early trading this morning, with South Korean shares triggering a circuit breaker that halted trading for 20 minutes. The KOSPI fell below the 5,000 level, trading at 4,923 after the open, down 460 points or 8.55%. The Nikkei also fell below 60,000, trading at 58,906 earlier, down 2,171 points or 3.55%.
summary.zh_hans: 日韩股市今早初段急挫，韩股触发熔断机制，暂停交易20分钟。首尔综合指数跌穿5000点关口，开市后报4923点，跌460点，跌幅8.55%。日经指数亦失守6万点关口，较早时报58906点，跌2171点，跌幅3.55%。

title.zh_hant: 兩名聯儲局官員齊撐漸進加息　哈瑪克：小步多次衝擊較小　美元主導地位未動搖
title.en: Two Fed officials back gradual rate hikes; Hammack says smaller, more frequent moves hit households less and the dollar's dominance is intact
title.zh_hans: 两名联储局官员齐撑渐进加息　哈玛克：小步多次冲击较小　美元主导地位未动摇

summary.zh_hant: 美國里奇蒙聯邦儲備銀行總裁巴爾金表示，在需求強勁、失業率較低、價格壓力廣泛之下，通脹持續高於聯儲局2%的目標，認為應漸進加息。克利夫蘭聯邦儲備銀行總裁哈瑪克亦支持漸進式加息，認為有助降低政策落後於應有水平、導致通脹預期根深柢固的風險；她相信更頻繁但幅度較小的利率調整，對家庭、企業及金融市場造成的衝擊較小。哈瑪克又提到，美元在全球外匯儲備的佔比或已見頂，但不認為美元會失去主導地位；加密貨幣價格波動劇烈，作為價值儲存工具的確定性較低，目前似乎不具備取代美元的條件。
summary.en: Richmond Federal Reserve president Thomas Barkin said that with demand staying strong, unemployment low and price pressures broad-based, inflation remains above the Fed's 2% target and rates should rise gradually. Cleveland Fed president Beth Hammack also backed gradual rate hikes, saying they would help reduce the risk of policy falling behind and inflation expectations becoming entrenched; she believes more frequent but smaller rate moves would hit households, businesses and financial markets less. Hammack added that the dollar's share of global foreign-exchange reserves may have peaked, but she does not believe the dollar will lose its dominant position, and that cryptocurrencies, with their sharp price swings, currently do not appear able to replace the dollar as a store of value.
summary.zh_hans: 美国里奇蒙联邦储备银行总裁巴尔金表示，在需求强劲、失业率较低、价格压力广泛之下，通胀持续高于联储局2%的目标，认为应渐进加息。克利夫兰联邦储备银行总裁哈玛克亦支持渐进式加息，认为有助降低政策落后于应有水平、导致通胀预期根深柢固的风险；她相信更频繁但幅度较小的利率调整，对家庭、企业及金融市场造成的冲击较小。哈玛克又提到，美元在全球外汇储备的占比或已见顶，但不认为美元会失去主导地位；加密货币价格波动剧烈，作为价值储存工具的确定性较低，目前似乎不具备取代美元的条件。

title.zh_hant: 美元指數創逾5星期低位　美債息創近兩個月新低　英倫銀行3年多來首加息
title.en: US dollar index hits lowest in over five weeks as Treasury yields fall to near two-month low; Bank of England raises rates for first time in over three years
title.zh_hans: 美元指数创逾5星期低位　美债息创近两个月新低　英伦银行3年多来首加息

summary.zh_hant: 美元指數最多跌約0.3%，低見101.18，再創逾5星期低位，尾市回升至101.59。美債孳息率大幅下跌，創近兩個月低位，10年期債息低見4.814厘，跌近8個基點；30年期債息低見約5.23厘，兩年期債息低見4.452厘。其他貨幣方面，澳元兌美元跌逾1%，紐約尾市報0.693，新西蘭元兌美元亦跌至0.56以下；英鎊兌美元跌至1.345附近，歐元兌美元貼近1.122水平。英倫銀行3年多以來首次加息，央行總裁貝利表示，今次加息不應被視為開啟長期加息行動，但如果美伊衝突持續，或需要進一步加息；歐洲央行總裁拉加德表示，將評估各項經濟數據，以決定12月是否加息。
summary.en: The US dollar index fell as much as about 0.3% to 101.18, its lowest in over five weeks, before recovering to 101.59 late in New York trading. US Treasury yields fell sharply to near two-month lows, with the 10-year yield touching 4.814%, down nearly 8 basis points; the 30-year yield fell to about 5.23% and the two-year yield to 4.452%. Among other currencies, the Australian dollar fell more than 1% against the US dollar to 0.693 in late New York trading, and the New Zealand dollar also slipped below 0.56; sterling fell to around 1.345 and the euro traded near 1.122. The Bank of England raised interest rates for the first time in more than three years; governor Andrew Bailey said the move should not be seen as the start of a prolonged tightening cycle, but further hikes might be needed if the US-Iran conflict persists. European Central Bank president Christine Lagarde said the bank would assess economic data before deciding whether to raise rates in December.
summary.zh_hans: 美元指数最多跌约0.3%，低见101.18，再创逾5星期低位，尾市回升至101.59。美债孳息率大幅下跌，创近两个月低位，10年期债息低见4.814厘，跌近8个基点；30年期债息低见约5.23厘，两年期债息低见4.452厘。其他货币方面，澳元兑美元跌逾1%，纽约尾市报0.693，新西兰元兑美元亦跌至0.56以下；英镑兑美元跌至1.345附近，欧元兑美元贴近1.122水平。英伦银行3年多以来首次加息，央行总裁贝利表示，今次加息不应被视为开启长期加息行动，但如果美伊冲突持续，或需要进一步加息；欧洲央行总裁拉加德表示，将评估各项经济数据，以决定12月是否加息。

title.zh_hant: 海關關長：用大數據＋AI＋先進X光機堵截違禁品　已與3大電商平台簽備忘錄
title.en: Customs chief: big data, AI and advanced X-ray scanners to intercept contraband; pacts signed with three largest e-commerce platforms
title.zh_hans: 海关关长：用大数据＋AI＋先进X光机堵截违禁品　已与3大电商平台签备忘录

summary.zh_hant: 海關關長陳子達表示，隨著網購愈來愈普及，海關已採取多層次方案防止違禁品進出香港，包括收集貨物數據、與業界合作及利用先進檢查設備，提升堵截違禁品的能力。海關今年已完成貿易單一窗口第三階段A期，陸路貨物數據可經平台向海關提供，並透過大數據分析及人工智能算法找出異常或高風險貨品檢查；海關亦利用先進X光機檢查貨櫃，並與3間最大的電商平台簽訂諒解備忘錄，預先通報高風險貨品資料。在招聘方面，陳子達說海關過去兩年流失率已大幅降低，近年各崗位招聘均有幾千至過萬人申請；海關近年亦吸納不少具運動員背景的人士加入，認為運動員的體魄、服從性及團隊精神與紀律部隊非常吻合，是雙贏安排。
summary.en: Commissioner of Customs and Excise Chan Tsz-tat said that as online shopping becomes more common, Customs has adopted a multi-layered approach to stop contraband entering and leaving Hong Kong, including collecting cargo data, working with industry and using advanced inspection equipment. Customs completed phase 3A of the third stage of the Trade Single Window this year, allowing land cargo data to be submitted through the platform and using big-data analysis and AI algorithms to flag abnormal or high-risk goods for inspection; it also uses advanced X-ray machines to scan containers and has signed memorandums of understanding with the three largest e-commerce platforms to share advance information on high-risk goods. On recruitment, Chan said staff attrition has fallen sharply over the past two years, with recent recruitment exercises drawing several thousand to more than ten thousand applicants per post; Customs has also recruited people with an athletic background, whose fitness, discipline and team spirit fit well with a disciplined service — a win-win arrangement.
summary.zh_hans: 海关关长陈子达表示，随着网购愈来愈普及，海关已采取多层次方案防止违禁品进出香港，包括收集货物数据、与业界合作及利用先进检查设备，提升堵截违禁品的能力。海关今年已完成贸易单一窗口第三阶段A期，陆路货物数据可经平台向海关提供，并透过大数据分析及人工智能算法找出异常或高风险货品检查；海关亦利用先进X光机检查货柜，并与3间最大的电商平台签订谅解备忘录，预先通报高风险货品资料。在招聘方面，陈子达说海关过去两年流失率已大幅降低，近年各岗位招聘均有几千至过万人申请；海关近年亦吸纳不少具运动员背景的人士加入，认为运动员的体魄、服从性及团队精神与纪律部队非常吻合，是双赢安排。

title.zh_hant: 美股暴瀉　道指插1833點、納指瀉5.5%　AI股重災　費城半導體瀉逾12%
title.en: US stocks plunge: Dow tumbles 1,833 points, Nasdaq dives 5.5% as AI shares crash; Philadelphia chip index down over 12%
title.zh_hans: 美股暴泻　道指插1833点、纳指泻5.5%　AI股重灾　费城半导体泻逾12%

summary.zh_hant: 美股三大指數急挫逾3%至5.5%，創去年4月以來最大單日跌幅，回吐美國中期選舉後的升幅。人工智能相關股份是跌市重災區，多隻晶片及光通信股暴跌一成多至逾兩成，市場憂慮人工智能監管收緊。道瓊斯指數收報51523點，跌1833點，跌幅逾3.4%，創約一個月新低；標普500指數收報7353點，跌334點，跌幅約4.4%，創逾三個月低位，指數成份股市值單日蒸發約3萬億美元。納斯達克指數收報24315點，跌1421點，跌幅逾5.5%，創約六個半月低位，較10月6日創下的收市紀錄高位回落近12%，確認進入技術回調區間。俗稱「恐慌指數」的VIX指數急升約70%，升至逾七個月高位。費城半導體指數跌逾12%，是逾六年半以來最大單日跌幅，Sandisk跌逾22%，AMD、西部數據、美光、Lumentum跌逾17%至近19%；SpaceX、Nvidia、高通、英特爾、Tesla亦跌9%至近11%。據報蘋果擬發債集資約70億美元，股價跌1.5%收市。
summary.en: US stocks plunged, with the three major indices down more than 3% to 5.5% in the biggest single-day fall since April last year, giving back gains made after the US midterm elections. AI-related shares were hit hardest, with several chip and optical-communications stocks crashing by more than 10% to over 20% amid worries about tighter AI regulation. The Dow closed at 51,523, down 1,833 points or over 3.4%, a roughly one-month low; the S&P 500 closed at 7,353, down 334 points or about 4.4%, a more than three-month low, wiping about US$3 trillion off the market value of its constituents in a day. The Nasdaq closed at 24,315, down 1,421 points or over 5.5%, a roughly six-and-a-half-month low and nearly 12% below its record close on 6 October, confirming a technical correction. The VIX, known as the fear index, surged about 70% to a more than seven-month high. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell over 12%, its biggest one-day drop in more than six and a half years; Sandisk fell over 22%, while AMD, Western Digital, Micron and Lumentum fell more than 17% to nearly 19%. SpaceX, Nvidia, Qualcomm, Intel and Tesla also fell 9% to nearly 11%. Apple reportedly plans to raise about US$7 billion in a bond issue and closed 1.5% lower.
summary.zh_hans: 美股三大指数急挫逾3%至5.5%，创去年4月以来最大单日跌幅，回吐美国中期选举后的升幅。人工智能相关股份是跌市重灾区，多只芯片及光通信股暴跌一成多至逾两成，市场忧虑人工智能监管收紧。道琼斯指数收报51523点，跌1833点，跌幅逾3.4%，创约一个月新低；标普500指数收报7353点，跌334点，跌幅约4.4%，创逾三个月低位，指数成份股市值单日蒸发约3万亿美元。纳斯达克指数收报24315点，跌1421点，跌幅逾5.5%，创约六个半月低位，较10月6日创下的收市纪录高位回落近12%，确认进入技术回调区间。俗称「恐慌指数」的VIX指数急升约70%，升至逾七个月高位。费城半导体指数跌逾12%，是逾六年半以来最大单日跌幅，Sandisk跌逾22%，AMD、西部数据、美光、Lumentum跌逾17%至近19%；SpaceX、Nvidia、高通、英特尔、Tesla亦跌9%至近11%。据报苹果拟发债集资约70亿美元，股价跌1.5%收市。

title.zh_hant: 金價升穿4100美元　高見4146美元　創逾半個月新高
title.en: Gold breaks above US$4,100, hits US$4,146.63 for highest in over half a month
title.zh_hans: 金价升穿4100美元　高见4146美元　创逾半个月新高

summary.zh_hant: 金價造好，由於美元及美債孳息率下跌。現貨金曾升穿每盎司4100美元水平，高見4146.63美元，升逾2.1%，創逾半個月新高，較早時徘徊4088美元以上。紐約期金12月合約收報4113.5美元，升約1%。
summary.en: Gold prices rose as the US dollar and Treasury yields fell. Spot gold broke above US$4,100 an ounce, reaching as high as US$4,146.63, up more than 2.1% and the highest in over half a month, after earlier hovering above US$4,088. Gold futures for December delivery in New York closed at US$4,113.5, up about 1%.
summary.zh_hans: 金价造好，由于美元及美债孳息率下跌。现货金曾升穿每盎司4100美元水平，高见4146.63美元，升逾2.1%，创逾半个月新高，较早时徘徊4088美元以上。纽约期金12月合约收报4113.5美元，升约1%。

title.zh_hant: 油價反彈　布蘭特期油升近4%　波斯灣油輪遇襲　供應憂慮升溫
title.en: Oil prices rebound: Brent crude up nearly 4% after tanker attacked in the Gulf, stoking supply worries
title.zh_hans: 油价反弹　布兰特期油升近4%　波斯湾油轮遇袭　供应忧虑升温

summary.zh_hant: 油價反彈，波斯灣地區有油輪遭到襲擊，加劇市場對石油供應的擔憂。布蘭特期油1月合約收報每桶98.29美元，升約3.9%。紐約期油12月合約一度升至91美元以上，收報90.52美元，升逾2.7%。
summary.en: Oil prices rebounded after a tanker was attacked in the Gulf region, heightening market worries about oil supply. Brent crude for January delivery closed at US$98.29 a barrel, up about 3.9%. US crude for December delivery rose above US$91 at one point before closing at US$90.52, up more than 2.7%.
summary.zh_hans: 油价反弹，波斯湾地区有油轮遭到袭击，加剧市场对石油供应的担忧。布兰特期油1月合约收报每桶98.29美元，升约3.9%。纽约期油12月合约一度升至91美元以上，收报90.52美元，升逾2.7%。

title.zh_hant: 克宮：俄烏和平途徑仍在　視乎烏方政治意願　俄利益與美國內形勢無關
title.en: Kremlin: path to peace in Ukraine remains if Kyiv shows political will; Russia's interests do not depend on US domestic politics
title.zh_hans: 克宫：俄乌和平途径仍在　视乎乌方政治意愿　俄利益与美国内形势无关

summary.zh_hant: 俄羅斯克里姆林宮發言人佩斯科夫表示，俄方優先通過和平方式實現目標，只要烏克蘭方面展現政治意願，和平解決途徑依然存在，但在和平途徑受阻的情況下，俄方將繼續進行特別軍事行動。他又說，俄羅斯在烏克蘭問題上的利益不取決於美國國內形勢，在任何情況下都將得到保障。對於有報道指三艘運往美國的俄羅斯柴油運油輪中，有兩艘因美國民主黨和當局對相關企業發出威脅而改變航向，佩斯科夫當地星期四在新聞簡報會表示，根據俄美雙方達成的協議，所有運往美國的俄羅斯柴油都將找到買家，呼籲外界不要將運油輪改變航向與美國中期選舉結果相聯繫。
summary.en: Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said Russia prioritises achieving its goals by peaceful means, and that a path to a peaceful settlement remains as long as Ukraine shows political will, but that Russia will continue its special military operation if the peaceful path is blocked. He added that Russia's interests on Ukraine do not depend on the US domestic situation and will be safeguarded under any circumstances. Asked about reports that two of three Russian diesel tankers bound for the US changed course after threats from the US Democratic Party and authorities against the companies involved, Peskov told a press briefing on Thursday local time that under an agreement between Russia and the US, all Russian diesel shipped to the US will find buyers, and urged people not to link the rerouting to the US midterm election results.
summary.zh_hans: 俄罗斯克里姆林宫发言人佩斯科夫表示，俄方优先通过和平方式实现目标，只要乌克兰方面展现政治意愿，和平解决途径依然存在，但在和平途径受阻的情况下，俄方将继续进行特别军事行动。他又说，俄罗斯在乌克兰问题上的利益不取决于美国国内形势，在任何情况下都将得到保障。对于有报道指三艘运往美国的俄罗斯柴油运油轮中，有两艘因美国民主党和当局对相关企业发出威胁而改变航向，佩斯科夫当地星期四在新闻简报会表示，根据俄美双方达成的协议，所有运往美国的俄罗斯柴油都将找到买家，呼吁外界不要将运油轮改变航向与美国中期选举结果相联系。

title.zh_hant: 梅拉妮婭白宮會晤俄烏代表　促成停火撤走近800人　籲化為持久和平
title.en: Melania Trump meets Russian and Ukrainian envoys at White House, urges ceasefire that evacuated nearly 800 people to become lasting peace
title.zh_hans: 梅拉妮娅白宫会晤俄乌代表　促成停火撤走近800人　吁化为持久和平

summary.zh_hant: 美國第一夫人梅拉妮婭在白宮會見俄羅斯和烏克蘭代表。她日前促成、在被俄羅斯控制的赫爾松州奧列什基地區達成為期6日的停火協議，俄羅斯總統特別代表德米特里耶夫獲簽證赴美出席紀念活動。梅拉妮婭說，停火期間有近800名居民安全撤離，感謝俄烏雙方合作，呼籲他們以奧列什基停火為起點，推動更廣泛的和平合作，令臨時停火發展成為更持久的和平。她分別寫信給俄烏總統，請雙方代表轉交。俄烏雙方分別向梅拉妮婭致送感謝禮物，俄方送上一幅由一名奧列什基女童畫的粉紅色愛心畫，宣稱這名女童選擇和家人一起生活在俄羅斯。烏方則向梅拉妮婭頒發國家獎章，感謝她拯救烏克蘭人民。
summary.en: US First Lady Melania Trump met Russian and Ukrainian representatives at the White House. She recently helped broker a six-day ceasefire in the Oleshky area of Kherson region, which is under Russian control, and Russian presidential special representative Dmitriev was granted a visa to travel to the US for a commemorative event. Melania Trump said nearly 800 residents were safely evacuated during the ceasefire, thanked both sides for their cooperation, and urged them to use the Oleshky ceasefire as a starting point for broader peace cooperation so the temporary truce can grow into more lasting peace. She wrote letters to the Russian and Ukrainian presidents and asked the representatives to deliver them. Both sides gave her gifts of thanks: Russia presented a pink heart drawing by a girl from Oleshky, saying the girl had chosen to live in Russia with her family, while Ukraine awarded her a national medal in thanks for saving Ukrainian people.
summary.zh_hans: 美国第一夫人梅拉妮娅在白宫会见俄罗斯和乌克兰代表。她日前促成、在被俄罗斯控制的赫尔松州奥列什基地区达成为期6日的停火协议，俄罗斯总统特别代表德米特里耶夫获签证赴美出席纪念活动。梅拉妮娅说，停火期间有近800名居民安全撤离，感谢俄乌双方合作，呼吁他们以奥列什基停火为起点，推动更广泛的和平合作，令临时停火发展成为更持久的和平。她分别写信给俄乌总统，请双方代表转交。俄乌双方分别向梅拉妮娅致送感谢礼物，俄方送上一幅由一名奥列什基女童画的粉红色爱心画，宣称这名女童选择和家人一起生活在俄罗斯。乌方则向梅拉妮娅颁发国家奖章，感谢她拯救乌克兰人民。

title.zh_hant: 澤連斯基晤歐洲理事會主席　磋商入盟談判　烏克蘭獲歐盟43.6億歐元貸款
title.en: Zelenskyy meets European Council president to discuss EU accession talks; Ukraine receives €4.36 billion EU loan
title.zh_hans: 泽连斯基晤欧洲理事会主席　磋商入盟谈判　乌克兰获欧盟43.6亿欧元贷款

summary.zh_hant: 烏克蘭總統澤連斯基與歐洲理事會主席科斯塔在西班牙馬德里會面。澤連斯基表示，雙方重點磋商烏克蘭加入歐盟談判進程、推動歐洲一體化的新方案，以及阿布扎比烏美俄三方會晤的籌備事宜。他提出歐洲應參與烏克蘭安全保障和戰後重建相關談判，有關主張得到科斯塔支持。另外，烏克蘭總理科列茨基在社交平台表示，烏克蘭收到歐盟一筆43億6千萬歐元的援助貸款，是歐盟4月正式批准向烏克蘭提供900億歐元援烏貸款一部分，為烏克蘭提供2026至27年的財政與軍事支持，支持烏克蘭維持國家基本運作、保障公共服務，並增強國防能力和國防工業實力。
summary.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy met European Council President Antonio Costa in Madrid, Spain. Zelenskyy said the talks focused on the progress of Ukraine's EU accession negotiations, new proposals to advance European integration, and preparations for a trilateral Ukraine-US-Russia meeting in Abu Dhabi. He proposed that Europe take part in negotiations on security guarantees for Ukraine and post-war reconstruction, a position Costa supported. Separately, Ukrainian Prime Minister Yuliia Svyrydenko said on social media that Ukraine had received a €4.36 billion EU assistance loan, part of the €90 billion in aid loans for Ukraine formally approved by the EU in April, providing fiscal and military support for 2026-27 to keep the country running, safeguard public services and strengthen its defence capabilities and defence industry.
summary.zh_hans: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基与欧洲理事会主席科斯塔在西班牙马德里会面。泽连斯基表示，双方重点磋商乌克兰加入欧盟谈判进程、推动欧洲一体化的新方案，以及阿布扎比乌美俄三方会晤的筹备事宜。他提出欧洲应参与乌克兰安全保障和战后重建相关谈判，有关主张得到科斯塔支持。另外，乌克兰总理科列茨基在社交平台表示，乌克兰收到欧盟一笔43亿6千万欧元的援助贷款，是欧盟4月正式批准向乌克兰提供900亿欧元援乌贷款一部分，为乌克兰提供2026至27年的财政与军事支持，支持乌克兰维持国家基本运作、保障公共服务，并增强国防能力和国防工业实力。

title.zh_hant: 歐股個別發展　英德跌逾0.4%　法股連升兩日創近兩個月高
title.en: European stocks mixed: UK and German markets down over 0.4%, French shares rise for a second day to near two-month high
title.zh_hans: 欧股个别发展　英德跌逾0.4%　法股连升两日创近两个月高

summary.zh_hant: 歐洲股市高開低走，收市個別發展。英國富時100指數收報10782點，跌46點，跌幅逾0.4%。德國DAX指數收報26325點，跌112點，跌幅逾0.4%。法國CAC指數收報8205點，升27點，升幅逾0.3%，連升兩日，創近兩個月新高。意大利股市低收1%，西班牙股市則升約0.6%。
summary.en: European stock markets opened higher but faded, closing mixed. The UK's FTSE 100 closed at 10,782, down 46 points or over 0.4%. Germany's DAX closed at 26,325, down 112 points or over 0.4%. France's CAC index closed at 8,205, up 27 points or over 0.3%, rising for a second straight day to a near two-month high. Italian shares closed 1% lower, while Spanish shares rose about 0.6%.
summary.zh_hans: 欧洲股市高开低走，收市个别发展。英国富时100指数收报10782点，跌46点，跌幅逾0.4%。德国DAX指数收报26325点，跌112点，跌幅逾0.4%。法国CAC指数收报8205点，升27点，升幅逾0.3%，连升两日，创近两个月新高。意大利股市低收1%，西班牙股市则升约0.6%。

title.zh_hant: 法國全國大罷工　60萬人上街抗議物價高漲　里昂爆衝突燒車
title.en: France hit by nationwide strike over cost of living; authorities say 600,000 took to the streets, clashes in Lyon
title.zh_hans: 法国全国大罢工　60万人上街抗议物价高涨　里昂爆冲突烧车

summary.zh_hant: 法國多個工會在當地星期四發起全國罷工示威，抗議生活成本上漲，要求全面加薪、推行稅制改革及改善年輕人的學習條件，獲得不少民眾響應。內政部表示約有60萬人參與示威，法國總工會則稱參加人數達到160萬；當局在全國部署7萬名警察及安全部隊。總理勒科爾尼將於下星期一與工會及僱主組織代表會面，討論生活成本與工資問題。法新社報道，星期四的抗議活動大致和平，但在包括里昂在內的部分城市，有示威者與警方爆發衝突，有汽車被燒毀，警方使用水砲及催淚氣體驅散示威者。
summary.en: French unions staged a nationwide strike on Thursday local time to protest the rising cost of living, demanding across-the-board pay rises, tax reform and better conditions for young people, drawing a large turnout. The Interior Ministry said about 600,000 people took part, while the CGT union put the figure at 1.6 million; authorities deployed 70,000 police and security personnel across the country. Prime Minister Lecornu will meet union and employer representatives on Monday to discuss living costs and wages. AFP reported the protests were largely peaceful, but in some cities including Lyon demonstrators clashed with police, cars were set on fire and officers used water cannon and tear gas to disperse crowds.
summary.zh_hans: 法国多个工会在当地星期四发起全国罢工示威，抗议生活成本上涨，要求全面加薪、推行税制改革及改善年轻人的学习条件，获得不少民众响应。内政部表示约有60万人参与示威，法国总工会则称参加人数达到160万；当局在全国部署7万名警察及安全部队。总理勒科尔尼将于下星期一与工会及雇主组织代表会面，讨论生活成本与工资问题。法新社报道，星期四的抗议活动大致和平，但在包括里昂在内的部分城市，有示威者与警方爆发冲突，有汽车被烧毁，警方使用水炮及催泪气体驱散示威者。

title.zh_hant: 安理會一致通過主席聲明　促武裝衝突中加強外交　巴基斯坦起草
title.en: UN Security Council unanimously adopts presidential statement urging stronger diplomacy in armed conflict; drafted by Pakistan
title.zh_hans: 安理会一致通过主席声明　促武装冲突中加强外交　巴基斯坦起草

summary.zh_hant: 聯合國安理會在當地星期四一致通過一項有關「加強外交在武裝衝突中的作用」的主席聲明。聲明草案由巴基斯坦起草，強調即使武裝衝突已經爆發，各方仍應保持外交接觸，對於控制衝突升級、推動停止敵對行動和實現停火，以及創造有利於通過和平政治方式解決爭端的條件，具有重要意義。
summary.en: The UN Security Council on Thursday local time unanimously adopted a presidential statement on strengthening the role of diplomacy in armed conflict. Drafted by Pakistan, the statement stresses that parties should maintain diplomatic engagement even after armed conflict has broken out, as it matters for controlling escalation, promoting a cessation of hostilities and a ceasefire, and creating conditions for resolving disputes through peaceful political means.
summary.zh_hans: 联合国安理会在当地星期四一致通过一项有关「加强外交在武装冲突中的作用」的主席声明。声明草案由巴基斯坦起草，强调即使武装冲突已经爆发，各方仍应保持外交接触，对于控制冲突升级、推动停止敌对行动和实现停火，以及创造有利于通过和平政治方式解决争端的条件，具有重要意义。

title.zh_hant: 以色列組閣大逆轉　埃森科特獲67席支持過半　阿拉伯政黨成關鍵
title.en: Israel coalition talks turn: Eisenkot wins backing of 67 seats, a Knesset majority, with Arab parties decisive
title.zh_hans: 以色列组阁大逆转　埃森科特获67席支持过半　阿拉伯政党成关键

summary.zh_hant: 以色列阿拉伯裔政黨聯盟「聯合名單」宣布，將向總統赫爾佐格提議授權正直黨領導人、前國防軍總參謀長埃森科特組建新政府。目前表態支持埃森科特組閣的政黨，在議會120席中合共佔67席，超過半數。以色列議會選舉官方結果日前公布，內塔尼亞胡陣營與埃森科特領導的反對派均未能取得單獨組閣所需的議席，需要爭取合共19席的阿拉伯裔政黨支持。赫爾佐格已於當地星期三晚開始與各黨派協商，聽取總理人選推薦；以色列傳媒分析指，雖然埃森科特獲總統授權組閣的機會明顯上升，但反對派內部對與阿拉伯裔政黨合作仍有分歧，議會多數推薦未必能轉化為實際組閣支持。
summary.en: Israel's Arab-led Joint List has announced it will recommend to President Isaac Herzog that Yashar party leader and former military chief of staff Gadi Eisenkot be tasked with forming a new government. Parties that have declared support for Eisenkot now hold 67 of the Knesset's 120 seats, more than half. Official results of the Israeli election were released earlier; neither Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's bloc nor the opposition led by Eisenkot won enough seats to govern alone, leaving both sides courting the Arab parties, which hold 19 seats between them. Herzog began consulting the parties on Wednesday evening local time to hear their recommendations for prime minister; Israeli media analysis says Eisenkot's chances of receiving the mandate have risen markedly, but divisions within the opposition over cooperating with the Arab parties mean the parliamentary majority in recommendations may not translate into actual support for forming a government.
summary.zh_hans: 以色列阿拉伯裔政党联盟「联合名单」宣布，将向总统赫尔佐格提议授权正直党领导人、前国防军总参谋长埃森科特组建新政府。目前表态支持埃森科特组阁的政党，在议会120席中合共占67席，超过半数。以色列议会选举官方结果日前公布，内塔尼亚胡阵营与埃森科特领导的反对派均未能取得单独组阁所需的议席，需要争取合共19席的阿拉伯裔政党支持。赫尔佐格已于当地星期三晚开始与各党派协商，听取总理人选推荐；以色列传媒分析指，虽然埃森科特获总统授权组阁的机会明显上升，但反对派内部对与阿拉伯裔政党合作仍有分歧，议会多数推荐未必能转化为实际组阁支持。

title.zh_hant: 中國一箭三星升空　遙感五十一號07-09星成功入軌　長征火箭第675飛
title.en: China launches three Yaogan-51 satellites in one rocket; Long March series marks 675th flight
title.zh_hans: 中国一箭三星升空　遥感五十一号07-09星成功入轨　长征火箭第675飞

summary.zh_hant: 中國昨晚11時58分在西昌衛星發射中心使用長征二號丙運載火箭，成功將遙感五十一號07-09星發射升空，衛星順利進入預定軌道，發射任務取得圓滿成功。據央視報道，有關衛星主要用於科學試驗及電磁環境探測等領域。今次任務是長征系列運載火箭的第675次飛行。
summary.en: China successfully launched the Yaogan-51 07-09 satellites aboard a Long March 2C carrier rocket from the Xichang Satellite Launch Centre at 11.58pm last night, with the satellites entering their planned orbit and the mission declared a complete success. State broadcaster CCTV said the satellites will mainly be used for scientific experiments and electromagnetic environment monitoring. The mission was the 675th flight of the Long March rocket series.
summary.zh_hans: 中国昨晚11时58分在西昌卫星发射中心使用长征二号丙运载火箭，成功将遥感五十一号07-09星发射升空，卫星顺利进入预定轨道，发射任务取得圆满成功。据央视报道，有关卫星主要用于科学试验及电磁环境探测等领域。今次任务是长征系列运载火箭的第675次飞行。

title.zh_hant: 紐約民居凌晨陷火海　6死7傷　火場發現鋰電池
title.en: Six killed and seven hurt in overnight Brooklyn house fire; lithium-ion battery found at scene
title.zh_hans: 纽约民居凌晨陷火海　6死7伤　火场发现锂电池

summary.zh_hant: 美國紐約布魯克林區一棟兩層高住宅樓宇在當地星期四凌晨約1時起火，火勢迅速蔓延至整棟建築，超過200名消防及應急人員到場救援。大火造成6人死亡、7人受傷，傷者包括居民及消防員。消防將火撲滅後，在火場發現鋰離子電池，但未確定是否與起火有關。紐約市長曼達尼形容今次是一場毀滅性火災，社區需要很長時間才能從悲痛中恢復過來。
summary.en: A two-storey residential building in Brooklyn's Sunset Park neighbourhood caught fire at about 1am local time on Thursday, with flames quickly engulfing the building and more than 200 firefighters and emergency responders attending. Six people were killed and seven injured, including residents and firefighters. A lithium-ion battery was found at the scene after the fire was put out, though it is not yet clear whether it caused the blaze. New York mayor Zohran Mamdani called the fire devastating, saying the community would need a long time to recover from the grief.
summary.zh_hans: 美国纽约布鲁克林区一栋两层高住宅楼宇在当地星期四凌晨约1时起火，火势迅速蔓延至整栋建筑，超过200名消防及应急人员到场救援。大火造成6人死亡、7人受伤，伤者包括居民及消防员。消防将火扑灭后，在火场发现锂离子电池，但未确定是否与起火有关。纽约市长曼达尼形容今次是一场毁灭性火灾，社区需要很长时间才能从悲痛中恢复过来。

title.zh_hant: 「銳眼」本月加入AI人臉識別　目標2028年6萬鏡頭全數可用
title.en: 'Sharp Eye' CCTV network adds AI facial recognition this month; all 60,000 cameras to be capable by 2028
title.zh_hans: 「锐眼」本月加入AI人脸识别　目标2028年6万镜头全数可用

summary.zh_hant: 警方「銳眼計劃」的閉路電視系統將於今個月內加入人工智能人臉識別功能，預計到2028年，全港合共6萬支鏡頭都可用作人臉識別，但基於算力考慮，不會同時全部使用。警方表示，測試期間曾在接報後約個半小時，尋回一名80多歲患有腦退化症的長者，亦曾憑疑犯的人臉特徵，偵測到他在一宗行劫案後再出現的位置並將他拘捕。警務處行動部高級警司梁銘亮形容，引入人臉識別如同多了警員24小時不眠不休監察鏡頭，可加快調查及節省人手。他強調，使用系統前須經授權，由受訓人員申請、督察級以上人員審批，使用後亦會複檢；截至上月底，「銳眼計劃」已協助偵破2,192宗罪案，影像儲存不超過31日，人臉識別數據不超過180日。
summary.en: Hong Kong police's 'Sharp Eye' CCTV network will add AI facial recognition this month, and all 60,000 cameras across the city are expected to be capable of the function by 2028, though computing power means they will not all run it at once. Police said tests had already helped find a dementia sufferer in his 80s about 90 minutes after a report, and tracked a robbery suspect to where he reappeared after the crime, leading to his arrest. Senior Superintendent Leung Ming-leung of the Operations Wing said facial recognition was like having officers watching cameras around the clock, speeding up investigations and saving manpower. He stressed use requires prior authorisation, applied for by trained staff and approved by officers of inspector rank or above, with a review afterwards. As of the end of last month the network had helped solve 2,192 cases; footage is kept for no more than 31 days and facial recognition data for no more than 180 days.
summary.zh_hans: 警方「锐眼计划」的闭路电视系统将于今个月内加入人工智能人脸识别功能，预计到2028年，全港合共6万支镜头都可用作人脸识别，但基于算力考虑，不会同时全部使用。警方表示，测试期间曾在接报后约个半小时，寻回一名80多岁患有脑退化症的长者，亦曾凭疑犯的人脸特征，侦测到他在一宗行劫案后再出现的位置并将他拘捕。警务处行动部高级警司梁铭亮形容，引入人脸识别如同多了警员24小时不眠不休监察镜头，可加快调查及节省人手。他强调，使用系统前须经授权，由受训人员申请、督察级以上人员审批，使用后亦会复检；截至上月底，「锐眼计划」已协助侦破2,192宗罪案，影像储存不超过31日，人脸识别数据不超过180日。

title.zh_hant: 「銳眼計劃」今年擴至私人機構　奧海城屯門市廣場率先接入
title.en: 'Sharp Eye' CCTV network extends to private sector this year, with Olympian City and Tuen Mun Town Plaza first to sign up
title.zh_hans: 「锐眼计划」今年扩至私人机构　奥海城屯门市广场率先接入

summary.zh_hant: 警方「銳眼計劃」將於今年內擴展至私人機構，目前已有數個商場同意將閉路電視系統接入。據了解，相關商場包括信和集團旗下的奧海城、屯門市廣場，房委會轄下的葵涌商場，以及房協位於粉嶺的「嶺．樂活」。警務處行動部高級警司梁銘亮表示，警方已諮詢法律專家及第三方機構，在法規及監管上都能滿足要求，並鼓勵商場增設標示，讓市民知道系統已接入「銳眼計劃」。他說，商場閉路電視接入後，日後案件涉及眾多地方時，警方不必再逐個地方申請翻看片段，可節省不少時間及人力；系統資訊保安達政府最高標準，以專網及獨家光纖傳輸，被黑客盜取資料的風險相當低。
summary.en: Hong Kong police's 'Sharp Eye' CCTV network will expand to private organisations this year, with several shopping malls already agreeing to connect their camera systems. The malls are understood to include Olympian City and Tuen Mun Town Plaza under Sino Group, a Housing Authority mall in Kwai Chung, and the Hong Kong Housing Society's 'Ling Living' in Fanling. Senior Superintendent Leung Ming-leung of the Operations Wing said police had consulted legal experts and third-party bodies and were satisfied on regulatory and oversight requirements, and encouraged malls to put up signs so the public knows their systems are connected. He said that once mall cameras are linked, police will no longer need to apply separately to view footage place by place when a case spans many locations, saving considerable time and manpower, and that information security meets the government's highest standard, using a dedicated network and exclusive fibre, so the risk of hackers stealing data is very low.
summary.zh_hans: 警方「锐眼计划」将于今年内扩展至私人机构，目前已有数个商场同意将闭路电视系统接入。据了解，相关商场包括信和集团旗下的奥海城、屯门市广场，房委会辖下的葵涌商场，以及房协位于粉岭的「岭．乐活」。警务处行动部高级警司梁铭亮表示，警方已咨询法律专家及第三方机构，在法规及监管上都能满足要求，并鼓励商场增设标示，让市民知道系统已接入「锐眼计划」。他说，商场闭路电视接入后，日后案件涉及众多地方时，警方不必再逐个地方申请翻看片段，可节省不少时间及人力；系统资讯保安达政府最高标准，以专网及独家光纤传输，被黑客盗取资料的风险相当低。

title.zh_hant: 澤連斯基：盼美中期選舉結果　助烏克蘭爭取更多援助
title.en: Zelenskyy hopes US midterm results will help Ukraine secure more American aid
title.zh_hans: 泽连斯基：盼美中期选举结果　助乌克兰争取更多援助

summary.zh_hant: 烏克蘭總統澤連斯基回應美國民主黨在中期選舉獲勝，表示希望選舉結果有助美國增加對烏克蘭的援助，並加強對俄羅斯的施壓。他認為美國民主共和兩黨均支持烏克蘭，對共和黨同樣表示感謝，又指如果美國國會討論向烏克蘭提供更多財政或軍事援助，或者能夠左右俄羅斯的決策、推動談判，達致和平。
summary.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, responding to the Democrats' wins in the US midterm elections, said he hoped the results would help the United States increase aid to Ukraine and step up pressure on Russia. He said both the Democratic and Republican parties support Ukraine and thanked the Republicans as well, adding that if the US Congress discusses giving Ukraine more financial or military aid, it could influence Russia's decisions, push negotiations forward and bring peace.
summary.zh_hans: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基回应美国民主党在中期选举获胜，表示希望选举结果有助美国增加对乌克兰的援助，并加强对俄罗斯的施压。他认为美国民主共和两党均支持乌克兰，对共和党同样表示感谢，又指如果美国国会讨论向乌克兰提供更多财政或军事援助，或者能够左右俄罗斯的决策、推动谈判，达致和平。

title.zh_hant: 美國生產率勁升3.6%遠超預期　勞動成本逾年來首跌
title.en: US productivity jumps 3.6% in third quarter, beating forecasts, as unit labour costs fall for first time in over a year
title.zh_hans: 美国生产率劲升3.6%远超预期　劳动成本逾年来首跌

summary.zh_hant: 美國勞工部勞工統計局公布，美國第3季非農生產率以年率計增長3.6%，增幅高過第2季向上修訂後的2.1%，亦高過市場預期的2.8%；按年計則增長2.1%。期內單位勞動力成本以年率計下跌0.7%，是去年第2季以來首次下跌，市場原先預計增長0.6%，第2季增幅則向上修訂至1.9%。
summary.en: The US Bureau of Labor Statistics said nonfarm productivity grew at an annualised 3.6 per cent in the third quarter, above the second quarter's upwardly revised 2.1 per cent and the market expectation of 2.8 per cent; it rose 2.1 per cent from a year earlier. Unit labour costs fell at an annualised 0.7 per cent in the quarter, the first decline since the second quarter of last year, against a market forecast of a 0.6 per cent rise; the second-quarter increase was revised up to 1.9 per cent.
summary.zh_hans: 美国劳工部劳工统计局公布，美国第3季非农生产率以年率计增长3.6%，增幅高过第2季向上修订后的2.1%，亦高过市场预期的2.8%；按年计则增长2.1%。期内单位劳动力成本以年率计下跌0.7%，是去年第2季以来首次下跌，市场原先预计增长0.6%，第2季增幅则向上修订至1.9%。

title.zh_hant: 美股初段急挫　納指瀉570點跌2.2%
title.en: Nasdaq tumbles 570 points, down 2.2%, in early US trading
title.zh_hans: 美股初段急挫　纳指泻570点跌2.2%

summary.zh_hant: 美股在開市初段下跌，納斯達克指數跌逾2%。納斯達克指數報25,166點，跌570點，跌幅2.22%；道瓊斯指數較早時報53,333點，跌22點；標準普爾500指數報7,605點，跌83點，跌幅1.08%。
summary.en: US stocks fell in early trading, with the Nasdaq down more than 2 per cent. The Nasdaq stood at 25,166 points, down 570 points or 2.22 per cent; the Dow Jones was earlier at 53,333 points, down 22 points; and the S&P 500 was at 7,605 points, down 83 points or 1.08 per cent.
summary.zh_hans: 美股在开市初段下跌，纳斯达克指数跌逾2%。纳斯达克指数报25,166点，跌570点，跌幅2.22%；道琼斯指数较早时报53,333点，跌22点；标准普尔500指数报7,605点，跌83点，跌幅1.08%。
